          }
        },
        "contents": "# Bundler: Vite\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**主要ファイル**:\n\n- &#96;src-tauri/Cargo.toml&#96; - Rust依存関係\n- &#96;src-tauri/tauri.conf.json&#96; - Tauri設定\n- &#96;src-tauri/src/main.rs&#96; - エントリーポイント\n- &#96;src/&#96; - React frontend\n\n**依存関係追加**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n# Cargo.toml\ntauri = { version = \"2.0\", features = [\"system-tray\", \"notification\"] }\nnotify = \"6.1\"  # File system watcher\ntokio = { version = \"1.42\", features = [\"full\"] }\nserde = { version = \"1.0\", features = [\"derive\"] }\ncodex-core = { path = \"../codex-rs/core\" }  # 既存コア統合\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 1.2 システムトレイ統合\n\n**実装箇所**: &#96;src-tauri/src/tray.rs&#96;\n\n**機能**:\n\n- トレイアイコン表示（Codexロゴ）\n- コンテキストメニュー（Show/Hide, Start/Stop Monitoring, Quit）\n- 通知表示（ファイル変更検知時）\n- 左クリック: ウィンドウ表示/非表示\n- 右クリック: メニュー表示\n\n**メニュー構成**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────┐\n│ 📊 Dashboard を開く      │\n│ ───────────────────────  │\n│ ✅ ファイル監視: ON      │\n│ 🔄 Codex Core: 起動中    │\n│ ───────────────────────  │\n│ ⚙️ Settings              │\n│ 📖 Docs                  │\n│ ❌ Quit                  │\n└─────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 1.3 自動起動設定\n\n**実装箇所**: &#96;src-tauri/src/autostart.rs&#96;\n\n**機能**:\n\n- Windows起動時に自動起動\n- レジストリ登録: &#96;HKEY_CURRENT_USER\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run&#96;\n- UI設定でON/OFF切り替え可能\n\n## Phase 2: ファイルシステム監視\n\n### 2.1 Windows File System Watcher\n\n**実装箇所**: &#96;src-tauri/src/watcher.rs&#96;\n\n**使用ライブラリ**: &#96;notify&#96; (cross-platform, Windows backend: ReadDirectoryChangesW)\n\n**監視対象**:\n\n- ワークスペースディレクトリ（ユーザー指定）\n- &#96;.gitignore&#96; 尊重\n- フィルター: &#96;.rs&#96;, &#96;.ts&#96;, &#96;.py&#96;, &#96;.md&#96;, &#96;.toml&#96;, etc.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Bundler: Vite",

        "contents": "# Bundler: Vite\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**主要ファイル**:\n\n- &#96;src-tauri/Cargo.toml&#96; - Rust依存関係\n- &#96;src-tauri/tauri.conf.json&#96; - Tauri設定\n- &#96;src-tauri/src/main.rs&#96; - エントリーポイント\n- &#96;src/&#96; - React frontend\n\n**依存関係追加**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n# Cargo.toml\ntauri = { version = \"2.0\", features = [\"system-tray\", \"notification\"] }\nnotify = \"6.1\"  # File system watcher\ntokio = { version = \"1.42\", features = [\"full\"] }\nserde = { version = \"1.0\", features = [\"derive\"] }\ncodex-core = { path = \"../codex-rs/core\" }  # 既存コア統合\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 1.2 システムトレイ統合\n\n**実装箇所**: &#96;src-tauri/src/tray.rs&#96;\n\n**機能**:\n\n- トレイアイコン表示（Codexロゴ）\n- コンテキストメニュー（Show/Hide, Start/Stop Monitoring, Quit）\n- 通知表示（ファイル変更検知時）\n- 左クリック: ウィンドウ表示/非表示\n- 右クリック: メニュー表示\n\n**メニュー構成**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────┐\n│ 📊 Dashboard を開く      │\n│ ───────────────────────  │\n│ ✅ ファイル監視: ON      │\n│ 🔄 Codex Core: 起動中    │\n│ ───────────────────────  │\n│ ⚙️ Settings              │\n│ 📖 Docs                  │\n│ ❌ Quit                  │\n└─────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 1.3 自動起動設定\n\n**実装箇所**: &#96;src-tauri/src/autostart.rs&#96;\n\n**機能**:\n\n- Windows起動時に自動起動\n- レジストリ登録: &#96;HKEY_CURRENT_USER\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run&#96;\n- UI設定でON/OFF切り替え可能\n\n## Phase 2: ファイルシステム監視\n\n### 2.1 Windows File System Watcher\n\n**実装箇所**: &#96;src-tauri/src/watcher.rs&#96;\n\n**使用ライブラリ**: &#96;notify&#96; (cross-platform, Windows backend: ReadDirectoryChangesW)\n\n**監視対象**:\n\n- ワークスペースディレクトリ（ユーザー指定）\n- &#96;.gitignore&#96; 尊重\n- フィルター: &#96;.rs&#96;, &#96;.ts&#96;, &#96;.py&#96;, &#96;.md&#96;, &#96;.toml&#96;, etc.",

{
  "plan": "# MCPツール動的ロード機能実装計画\n\n## アーキテクチャ概要\n\n現在のMCP実装は起動時に設定ファイル（&#96;config.toml&#96;、&#96;.codex/mcp-servers.yaml&#96;）から読み込む静的ロード方式です。これを拡張して、実行時にMCPサーバーを追加・削除・更新できる動的ロード機能を実装します。\n\n## 実装コンポーネント\n\n### 1. 動的ロードマネージャー (&#96;DynamicMcpLoader&#96;)\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/mcp_dynamic_loader.rs&#96; (新規作成)\n\n**責務**:\n- MCPサーバーの動的追加・削除・更新\n- プラグインディレクトリの監視\n- 設定ファイルのホットリロード\n- APIエンドポイント経由の操作\n\n**主要メソッド**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\npub struct DynamicMcpLoader {\n    connection_manager: Arc&lt;McpConnectionManager&gt;,\n    plugin_dir: PathBuf,\n    file_watcher: Option&lt;FileWatcher&gt;,\n    api_server: Option&lt;ApiServer&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl DynamicMcpLoader {\n    pub async fn add_server(&amp;self, config: McpServerConfig) -&gt; Result&lt;String&gt;;\n    pub async fn remove_server(&amp;self, server_name: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt;;\n    pub async fn reload_server(&amp;self, server_name: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt;;\n    pub async fn list_servers(&amp;self) -&gt; Vec&lt;String&gt;;\n    pub async fn start_file_watcher(&amp;mut self) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt;;\n    pub async fn start_api_server(&amp;mut self, port: u16) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt;;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. ファイルシステム監視 (&#96;McpFileWatcher&#96;)\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/mcp_file_watcher.rs&#96; (新規作成)\n\n**責務**:\n- 設定ファイル（&#96;.codex/mcp-servers.yaml&#96;）の変更監視\n- プラグインディレクトリ（&#96;.codex/mcp-plugins/&#96;）の監視\n- 変更検出時の自動リロード\n\n**実装**:\n- &#96;notify&#96;クレートを使用（既存の依存関係を確認）\n- または&#96;tokio::fs&#96;とポーリング方式\n\n### 3. プラグインシステム (&#96;McpPluginLoader&#96;)\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/mcp_plugin_loader.rs&#96; (新規作成)\n\n**責務**:\n- プラグインディレクトリからMCPサーバー設定を自動検出\n- プラグインメタデータ（&#96;plugin.toml&#96;）の読み込み\n- プラグインの有効化・無効化\n\n**プラグイン構造**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n.codex/mcp-plugins/\n├── github-plugin/\n│   ├── plugin.toml      # プラグインメタデータ\n│   └── server.toml      # MCPサーバー設定\n└── serena-plugin/\n    ├── plugin.toml\n    └── server.toml\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. APIエンドポイント (&#96;McpApiServer&#96;)\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/mcp_api_server.rs&#96; (新規作成)\n\n**責務**:\n- REST API経由でMCPサーバーを操作\n- 認証・認可（オプション）\n\n**エンドポイント**:\n- &#96;POST /api/mcp/servers&#96; - サーバー追加\n- &#96;DELETE /api/mcp/servers/{name}&#96; - サーバー削除\n- &#96;PUT /api/mcp/servers/{name}/reload&#96; - サーバーリロード\n- &#96;GET /api/mcp/servers&#96; - サーバー一覧\n- &#96;GET /api/mcp/servers/{name}/tools&#96; - ツール一覧\n\n### 5. CLIコマンド拡張\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/mcp_cmd.rs&#96; (既存ファイルを拡張)\n\n**追加コマンド**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\n// 既存のmcp_cmd.rsに追加\npub async fn handle_dynamic_load(\n    cmd: McpDynamicCommand,\n    loader: Arc&lt;DynamicMcpLoader&gt;,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n    match cmd {\n        McpDynamicCommand::Add { config_path } =&gt; {\n            // 設定ファイルから読み込んで追加\n        }\n        McpDynamicCommand::Remove { name } =&gt; {\n            // サーバーを削除\n        }\n        McpDynamicCommand::Reload { name } =&gt; {\n            // サーバーをリロード\n        }\n        McpDynamicCommand::List =&gt; {\n            // サーバー一覧を表示\n        }\n        McpDynamicCommand::Watch =&gt; {\n            // ファイル監視を開始\n        }\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 実装手順\n\n### Phase 1: コア動的ロード機能\n\n1. **&#96;DynamicMcpLoader&#96;の実装**\n   - &#96;McpConnectionManager&#96;への参照を保持\n   - &#96;add_server&#96;、&#96;remove_server&#96;、&#96;reload_server&#96;メソッドを実装\n   - サーバー状態管理（&#96;HashMap&lt;String, ServerState&gt;&#96;）\n\n2. **&#96;McpConnectionManager&#96;の拡張**\n   - 既存の&#96;initialize&#96;メソッドを拡張\n   - &#96;add_server_dynamic&#96;、&#96;remove_server_dynamic&#96;メソッドを追加\n   - サーバー接続のライフサイクル管理を改善\n\n### Phase 2: ファイル監視機能\n\n1. **&#96;McpFileWatcher&#96;の実装**\n   - &#96;notify&#96;クレートを使用（またはポーリング方式）\n   - 設定ファイル変更の検出\n   - 変更時の自動リロード\n\n2. **設定ファイルの統合**\n   - &#96;.codex/mcp-servers.yaml&#96;の変更監視\n   - プラグインディレクトリ（&#96;.codex/mcp-plugins/&#96;）の監視\n\n### Phase 3: プラグインシステム\n\n1. **プラグイン構造の定義**\n   - &#96;plugin.toml&#96;スキーマ定義\n   - プラグインメタデータ構造体\n\n2. **&#96;McpPluginLoader&#96;の実装**\n   - プラグインディレクトリのスキャン\n   - プラグインの自動ロード\n   - 有効化・無効化機能\n\n### Phase 4: APIエンドポイント\n\n1. **&#96;McpApiServer&#96;の実装**\n   - &#96;McpDynamicCommand&#96; enumの追加\n   - 各コマンドのハンドラー実装\n\n2. **コマンドライン引数の追加**\n   - &#96;codex mcp add --config &lt;path&gt;&#96;\n   - &#96;codex mcp remove --name &lt;name&gt;&#96;\n   - &#96;codex mcp reload --name &lt;name&gt;&#96;\n   - &#96;codex mcp list&#96;\n   - &#96;codex mcp watch&#96;\n\n## データ構造\n\n### プラグインメタデータ (&#96;plugin.toml&#96;)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[plugin]\nname = \"github-plugin\"\nversion = \"1.0.0\"\ndescription = \"GitHub integration MCP server\"\nauthor = \"zapabob\"\nenabled = true\n\n[server]\n# MCPサーバー設定（既存のMcpServerConfig形式）\ncommand = \"node\"\nargs = [\"dist/github-mcp-server.js\"]\nenv = { GITHUB_TOKEN = \"${GITHUB_TOKEN}\" }\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### サーバー状態管理\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nstruct ServerState {\n    name: String,\n    config: McpServerConfig,\n    connection: Option&lt;Arc&lt;ManagedClient&gt;&gt;,\n    status: ServerStatus,\n    last_updated: SystemTime,\n}\n\nenum ServerStatus {\n    Initializing,\n    Running,\n    Stopped,\n    Error(String),\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 統合ポイント\n\n### &#96;Config&#96;構造体の拡張\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/config/types.rs&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\npub struct Config {\n    // ... 既存フィールド\n    pub mcp_dynamic_loading: McpDynamicLoadingConfig,\n}\n\npub struct McpDynamicLoadingConfig {\n    pub enabled: bool,\n    pub plugin_dir: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n    pub watch_config_file: bool,\n    pub api_server_port: Option&lt;u16&gt;,\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### &#96;Codex&#96;構造体への統合\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/codex.rs&#96;\n\n- &#96;DynamicMcpLoader&#96;のインスタンスを保持\n- 初期化時に動的ロード機能を有効化（設定により）\n\n## エラーハンドリング\n\n- サーバー追加時の競合検出（同名サーバー）\n- サーバー削除時の接続切断処理\n- リロード時の状態遷移管理\n- ファイル監視エラーの処理\n\n## テスト戦略\n\n1. **ユニットテスト**\n   - &#96;DynamicMcpLoader&#96;の各メソッド\n   - プラグインローダーのテスト\n\n2. **統合テスト**\n   - ファイル監視の動作確認\n   - APIエンドポイントのテスト\n   - CLIコマンドのテスト\n\n3. **E2Eテスト**\n   - 実行中のサーバーへの動的追加・削除\n   - ホットリロードの動作確認\n\n## セキュリティ考慮事項\n\n- プラグインの検証（署名、チェックサム）\n- APIエンドポイントの認証\n- サンドボックス環境でのプラグイン実行\n- 設定ファイルのパーミッション確認\n\n## パフォーマンス考慮事項\n\n- ファイル監視の効率化（debounce）\n- サーバー追加・削除時の非同期処理\n- プラグインディレクトリのスキャン最適化\n\n## 依存関係の追加\n\n- &#96;notify&#96; -         "contents": "# Token Budget Management\n\n## Overview\n\nCodex includes a token budget tracking system to monitor and limit AI model token usage across agents and operations. This helps manage costs and prevent unexpected API expenses.\n\n## Configuration\n\n### Configuration File (&#96;.codex/config.toml&#96;)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[token_budget]\n# Total token budget (0 = unlimited)\ntotal_budget = 1000000\n\n# Warning threshold (percentage: 0-100)\nwarning_threshold = 80\n\n# Per-agent token limits\n[token_budget.per_agent_limits]\ncode-reviewer = 100000\ntest-gen = 50000\nsec-audit = 75000\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Environment Variables\n\nOverride configuration file settings:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Total token budget\nexport CODEX_TOKEN_BUDGET=1000000\n\n# Warning threshold\nexport CODEX_TOKEN_WARNING_THRESHOLD=80\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Usage Tracking\n\nThe token budget tracker automatically records usage for each:\n- Agent invocation\n- Model API call (prompt + completion tokens)\n- Timestamp of usage\n\n### Example Usage Data\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"agent_id\": \"code-reviewer\",\n  \"model\": \"gpt-4\",\n  \"prompt_tokens\": 1500,\n  \"completion_tokens\": 800,\n  \"total_tokens\": 2300,\n  \"timestamp\": 1698765432\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Budget Enforcement\n\n### Total Budget\n\nWhen total budget is set (non-zero):\n- Token usage is tracked across all agents\n- New requests are rejected if they would exceed the budget\n- Warning is emitted when usage crosses threshold\n\n### Per-Agent Limits\n\nConfigure limits for specific agents:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[token_budget.per_agent_limits]\nexpensive-agent = 50000  # This agent limited to 50K tokens\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nIf an agent exceeds its limit:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nError: Agent expensive-agent would exceed limit of 50000 tokens \n(current: 48000, requested: 3000)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Warning Thresholds\n\nWhen token usage crosses the warning threshold (default 80%):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nWARN: Token budget warning: 81.2% used (812000 / 1000000)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis warning is emitted once per session when threshold is crossed.\n\n## Status Reporting\n\n### Programmatic Status\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nuse codex_core::token_budget::TokenBudgetTracker;\n\nlet tracker = TokenBudgetTracker::with_defaults();\nlet status = tracker.get_status()?;\n\nprintln!(\"Total used: {}\", status.total_used);",

        "contents": "//! Token budget tracking and monitoring for AI agent usage.\n//!\n//! Provides thread-safe token usage tracking with configurable budgets,\n//! warning thresholds, and per-agent limits.\n\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse anyhow::anyhow;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::sync::RwLock;\n\n/// Helper to convert lock poisoned errors\nfn lock_poisoned_err&lt;T&gt;(_: T) -&gt; anyhow::Error {\n    anyhow!(\n        \"Token budget tracker lock is poisoned, indicating a panic occurred while holding the lock. This typically requires restarting the process.\"\n    )\n}\n\n/// Token usage entry for an agent\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct TokenUsage {\n    /// Agent identifier\n    pub agent_id: String,\n    /// Model used\n    pub model: String,\n    /// Prompt tokens consumed\n    pub prompt_tokens: u64,\n    /// Completion tokens generated\n    pub completion_tokens: u64,\n    /// Total tokens (prompt + completion)\n    pub total_tokens: u64,\n    /// Timestamp of usage\n    pub timestamp: u64,\n}\n\n/// Budget configuration\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct BudgetConfig {\n    /// Total token budget (0 = unlimited)\n    pub total_budget: u64,\n    /// Warning threshold (percentage: 0-100)\n    pub warning_threshold: u8,\n    /// Per-agent token limits\n    pub per_agent_limits: HashMap&lt;String, u64&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl Default for BudgetConfig {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            total_budget: 1_000_000, // 1M tokens default\n            warning_threshold: 80,   // 80% threshold\n            per_agent_limits: HashMap::new(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Token budget tracker (thread-safe)\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct TokenBudgetTracker {\n    inner: Arc&lt;RwLock&lt;TrackerInner&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\nstruct TrackerInner {\n    config: BudgetConfig,\n    usage_history: Vec&lt;TokenUsage&gt;,\n    total_used: u64,\n    agent_totals: HashMap&lt;String, u64&gt;,\n    warning_emitted: bool,\n}\n\nimpl TokenBudgetTracker {\n    /// Create a new tracker with the given configuration",

        "contents": "// トークン消費追跡と分担管理システム\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::sync::RwLock;\n\nuse crate::subagent::AgentType;\n\n/// トークン使用量\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct TokenUsage {\n    pub prompt_tokens: u64,\n    pub completion_tokens: u64,\n    pub total_tokens: u64,\n    pub timestamp: String,\n}\n\nimpl TokenUsage {\n    pub fn new(prompt_tokens: u64, completion_tokens: u64) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            prompt_tokens,\n            completion_tokens,\n            total_tokens: prompt_tokens + completion_tokens,\n            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn add(&amp;mut self, other: &amp;TokenUsage) {\n        self.prompt_tokens += other.prompt_tokens;\n        self.completion_tokens += other.completion_tokens;\n        self.total_tokens += other.total_tokens;\n    }\n}\n\n/// エージェント別トークン使用量\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentTokenUsage {\n    pub agent_type: AgentType,\n    pub agent_id: String,\n    pub total_usage: TokenUsage,\n    pub task_usages: Vec&lt;TaskTokenUsage&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl AgentTokenUsage {\n    pub fn new(agent_type: AgentType, agent_id: String) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            agent_type,\n            agent_id,\n            total_usage: TokenUsage::new(0, 0),\n            task_usages: Vec::new(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn add_task_usage(&amp;mut self, task_usage: TaskTokenUsage) {\n        self.total_usage.add(&amp;task_usage.usage);\n        self.task_usages.push(task_usage);\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_average_tokens_per_task(&amp;self) -&gt; f64 {\n        if self.task_usages.is_empty() {\n            return 0.0;\n        }\n        self.total_usage.total_tokens as f64 / self.task_usages.len() as f64\n    }\n}\n\n/// タスク別トークン使用量\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct TaskTokenUsage {\n    pub task_id: String,",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\agents\\budgeter.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 43,
            "column": 78
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 104
          }
        },
        "contents": " {\n        let mut used = self.used.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut agent_usage = self.agent_usage.lock().unwrap();\n        let agent_limits = self.agent_limits.lock().unwrap();\n\n        // 全体予算チェック\n        if *used + tokens &gt; self.total_budget {\n            warn!(\n                \"Total budget exceeded: {} + {} &gt; {}\",\n                *used, tokens, self.total_budget\n            );\n            return Ok(false);\n        }\n\n        // エージェント別予算チェック\n        let agent_used = agent_usage.get(agent_name).copied().unwrap_or(0);\n        if let Some(&amp;limit) = agent_limits.get(agent_name)\n            &amp;&amp; agent_used + tokens &gt; limit\n        {\n            warn!(\n                \"Agent '{}' budget exceeded: {} + {} &gt; {}\",\n                agent_name, agent_used, tokens, limit\n            );\n            return Ok(false);\n        }\n\n        // 使用量を更新\n        *used += tokens;\n        *agent_usage.entry(agent_name.to_string()).or_insert(0) += tokens;\n\n        debug!(\n            \"Agent '{}' consumed {} tokens (total: {}/{})\",\n            agent_name, tokens, *used, self.total_budget\n        );\n\n        Ok(true)\n    }\n\n    /// 強制的にトークンを消費（予算チェックなし）\n    pub fn force_consume(&amp;self, agent_name: &amp;str, tokens: usize) {\n        let mut used = self.used.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut agent_usage = self.agent_usage.lock().unwrap();\n\n        *used += tokens;\n        *agent_usage.entry(agent_name.to_string()).or_insert(0) += tokens;\n\n        debug!(\"Agent '{}' force consumed {} tokens\", agent_name, tokens);\n    }\n\n    /// 使用済みトークン数を取得\n    pub fn get_used(&amp;self) -&gt; usize {\n        *self.used.lock().unwrap()\n    }\n\n    /// 残りトークン数を取得\n    pub fn get_remaining(&amp;self) -&gt; usize {\n        let used = *self.used.lock().unwrap();\n        self.total_budget.saturating_sub(used)\n    }\n\n    /// エージェント別の使用量を取得",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": " {",
            "lineNumber": 44

        "contents": "use tokio::sync::Mutex;\nuse tokio::sync::oneshot;\nuse tokio::task::JoinSet;\nuse tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;\nuse tracing::instrument;\nuse tracing::warn;\n\nuse crate::codex::INITIAL_SUBMIT_ID;\nuse crate::config::types::McpServerConfig;\nuse crate::config::types::McpServerTransportConfig;\n\n/// Delimiter used to separate the server name from the tool name in a fully\n/// qualified tool name.\n///\n/// OpenAI requires tool names to conform to &#96;^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$&#96;, so we must\n/// choose a delimiter from this character set.\nconst MCP_TOOL_NAME_DELIMITER: &amp;str = \"__\";\nconst MAX_TOOL_NAME_LENGTH: usize = 64;\n\n/// Default timeout for initializing MCP server &amp; initially listing tools.\npub const DEFAULT_STARTUP_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);\n\n/// Default timeout for individual tool calls.\nconst DEFAULT_TOOL_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(60);\n\nfn qualify_tools&lt;I&gt;(tools: I) -&gt; HashMap&lt;String, ToolInfo&gt;\nwhere\n    I: IntoIterator&lt;Item = ToolInfo&gt;,\n{\n    let mut used_names = BTreeSet::new();\n    let mut qualified_tools = HashMap::new();\n    for tool in tools {\n        let mut qualified_name = format!(\n            \"mcp{}{}{}{}\",\n            MCP_TOOL_NAME_DELIMITER, tool.server_name, MCP_TOOL_NAME_DELIMITER, tool.tool_name\n        );\n        if qualified_name.len() &gt; MAX_TOOL_NAME_LENGTH {\n            let mut hasher = Sha1::new();\n            hasher.update(qualified_name.as_bytes());\n            let sha1 = hasher.finalize();\n            let sha1_str = format!(\"{sha1:x}\");\n\n            // Truncate to make room for the hash suffix\n            let prefix_len = MAX_TOOL_NAME_LENGTH - sha1_str.len();\n\n            qualified_name = format!(\"{}{}\", &amp;qualified_name[..prefix_len], sha1_str);\n        }\n\n        if used_names.contains(&amp;qualified_name) {\n            warn!(\"skipping duplicated tool {}\", qualified_name);\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        used_names.insert(qualified_name.clone());\n        qualified_tools.insert(qualified_name, tool);\n    }\n\n    qualified_tools\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub(crate) struct ToolInfo {\n    pub(crate) server_name: String,\n    pub(crate) tool_name: String,",

            "line": 1296,
            "column": 78
          }
        },
        "contents": "        let mut artifacts = Vec::new();\n\n        for iteration in 0..max_iterations {\n            debug!(\"Agent iteration {}/{}\", iteration + 1, max_iterations);\n\n            // LLM呼び出し\n            let llm_response = self\n                .call_llm_for_agent(&amp;conversation_history)\n                .await\n                .context(\"Failed to call LLM for agent\")?;\n\n            conversation_history.push((\"assistant\".to_string(), llm_response.clone()));\n            artifacts.push(llm_response.clone());\n\n            // ツールコール検出\n            let tool_calls = self.detect_tool_calls(&amp;llm_response);\n\n            if tool_calls.is_empty() {\n                // ツールコールがない場合は終了\n                info!(\"No more tool calls detected. Agent task completed.\");\n                break;\n            }\n\n            // ツール実行\n            let mut tool_results = Vec::new();\n            for (tool_name, tool_args) in tool_calls {\n                if !allowed_tools.contains(&amp;tool_name) {\n                    let error_msg =\n                        format!(\"ERROR: Tool '{tool_name}' is not permitted for this agent\");\n                    tool_results.push(error_msg);\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                info!(\n                    \"Executing Codex MCP tool: {} with args: {:?}\",\n                    tool_name, tool_args\n                );\n\n                match self\n                    .execute_codex_mcp_tool(&amp;mcp_client, &amp;tool_name, tool_args)\n                    .await\n                {\n                    Ok(result) =&gt; {\n                        tool_results.push(format!(\"TOOL_RESULT[{tool_name}]: {result}\"));\n                    }\n                    Err(e) =&gt; {\n                        let error_msg = format!(\"ERROR executing tool '{tool_name}': {e}\");\n                        error!(\"{error_msg}\");\n                        tool_results.push(error_msg);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // ツール結果をLLMにフィードバック\n            let feedback = tool_results.join(\"\\n\\n\");\n            conversation_history.push((\"user\".to_string(), feedback.clone()));",

        "contents": "# 🔧 Codex MCP Configuration Guide\n\n**Version**: codex-cli 0.47.0-alpha.1  \n**Last Updated**: 2025-10-12  \n**Configuration File**: &#96;~/.cursor/mcp.json&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 📋 Overview\n\nThis guide explains how to configure the Codex MCP (Model Context Protocol) server in Cursor IDE to leverage the production-ready meta-orchestration features.\n\n---\n\n## ⚙️ Configuration\n\n### Full &#96;mcp.json&#96; Entry\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"mcpServers\": {\n    \"codex\": {\n      \"command\": \"codex\",\n      \"args\": [\"mcp-server\"],\n      \"env\": {\n        \"RUST_LOG\": \"info\",\n        \"CODEX_CONFIG_PATH\": \"C:\\\\Users\\\\&lt;username&gt;\\\\.codex\\\\config.toml\"\n      },\n      \"description\": \"Codex MCP Server v0.47.0-alpha.1 - Production-Ready Meta-Orchestration System\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🛠️ Available Tools\n\n### 1. &#96;codex&#96;\n**Description**: Execute Codex with full capabilities\n\n**CLI Equivalent**: &#96;codex &lt;prompt&gt;&#96;\n\n**Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"tool\": \"codex\",\n  \"arguments\": {\n    \"prompt\": \"Implement user authentication with JWT\",\n    \"config\": {\n      \"model\": \"o3\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 2. &#96;codex-reply&#96;\n**Description**: Continue existing Codex conversation\n\n**Parameters**:\n- &#96;conversationId&#96; (string): Conversation ID to continue\n- &#96;prompt&#96; (string): Next user prompt\n\n**Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"tool\": \"codex-reply\",\n  \"arguments\": {\n    \"conversationId\": \"conv-abc123\",\n    \"prompt\": \"Now add password reset functionality\"\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 3. &#96;codex-supervisor&#96;\n**Description**: Coordinate multiple specialized AI agents\n\n**Parameters**:\n- &#96;goal&#96; (string): High-level goal to accomplish\n- &#96;agents&#96; (array, optional): Specific agent types to use\n- &#96;strategy&#96; (string, optional): Coordination strategy (&#96;sequential&#96;, &#96;parallel&#96;, &#96;hybrid&#96;)\n- &#96;merge_strategy&#96; (string, optional): Result merging (&#96;concatenate&#96;, &#96;voting&#96;, &#96;highest_score&#96;)\n\n**Available Agents**:\n- &#96;CodeExpert&#96; - Code implementation and refactoring\n- &#96;Researcher&#96; - Technology research and best practices\n- &#96;Tester&#96; - Test generation and coverage analysis\n- &#96;Security&#96; - Security audits and vulnerability scanning\n- &#96;Backend&#96; - Backend architecture and APIs",

Result&lt;HashMap&lt;String, u64&gt;&gt; {\n        let inner = self.inner.read().map_err(lock_poisoned_err)?;\n        Ok(inner.agent_totals.clone())",

        "contents": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nimpl McpClient {\n    /// トークン予算を考慮したツール呼び出し\n    pub async fn call_tool_with_budget(\n        &amp;self,\n        tool_name: String,\n        args: Option&lt;serde_json::Value&gt;,\n        budgeter: &amp;Arc&lt;TokenBudgeter&gt;,\n        agent_name: &amp;str,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;serde_json::Value&gt; {\n        // 推定トークン数\n        let estimated_tokens = match tool_name.as_str() {\n            \"codex-deep-research\" =&gt; 2000,  // Deep Research\n            \"codex-subagent\" =&gt; 1000,       // SubAgent\n            \"codex-supervisor\" =&gt; 1500,     // Supervisor\n            _ =&gt; 500,\n        };\n\n        // 予算チェック\n        if !budgeter.try_consume(agent_name, estimated_tokens)? {\n            anyhow::bail!(\"Token budget exceeded for MCP tool: {}\", tool_name);\n        }\n\n        // ツール実行\n        let result = self.call_tool(\n            tool_name.clone(),\n            args,\n            Some(Duration::from_secs(60))\n        ).await?;\n\n        // 監査ログ記録\n        info!(\"MCP tool '{}' consumed ~{} tokens\", tool_name, estimated_tokens);\n\n        Ok(result)\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 次のステップ\n\n### 即時（準備完了）\n- [x] ✅ MCPサーバービルド成功\n- [x] ✅ グローバルインストール完了\n- [x] ✅ 本番環境テスト成功（2/2）\n- [x] ✅ 7種類のツール確認\n- [x] ✅ M2依存関係クリア\n\n### M2実装時（2025-10-23）\n- [ ] MCP-Budgeter統合実装\n- [ ] トークン追跡ロギング\n- [ ] Deep Researchツールの強化\n- [ ] MCPツール呼び出しのモックテスト\n\n### M4実装時（2025-11-21～）\n- [ ] IDE拡張（VS Code/Cursor）のMCP統合UI\n- [ ] MCP Inspector対応\n- [ ] パフォーマンス最適化\n\n---\n\n## 📚 関連ドキュメント\n\n- &#96;docs/implementation-roadmap-v2.md&#96; - 実装計画書v2.0\n- &#96;codex-rs/BUILD_AND_INSTALL_GUIDE.md&#96; - ビルドガイド\n- &#96;_docs/2025-10-12_MCPサーバー本番環境テスト.md&#96; - テスト結果\n- MCP仕様: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/\n\n---",

        "contents": "{\n  \"mcpServers\": {\n    \"codex\": {\n      \"command\": \"codex\",\n      \"args\": [\"mcp-server\"],\n      \"env\": {\n        \"CODEX_WORKSPACE\": \"${workspaceFolder}\",\n        \"RUST_LOG\": \"info\",\n        \"OPENAI_API_KEY\": \"${OPENAI_API_KEY}\",\n        \"GITHUB_TOKEN\": \"${GITHUB_TOKEN}\"\n      },\n      \"description\": \"Codex AI orchestration and sub-agent coordination via MCP\"\n    },\n    \"codex-subagent\": {\n      \"command\": \"codex\",\n      \"args\": [\"mcp-server\"],\n      \"env\": {\n        \"CODEX_WORKSPACE\": \"${workspaceFolder}\",\n        \"RUST_LOG\": \"info\",\n        \"CODEX_MODE\": \"subagent\"\n      },\n      \"description\": \"Direct sub-agent execution (researcher, code-reviewer, test-gen, sec-audit)\"\n    },\n    \"codex-deep-research\": {\n      \"command\": \"codex\",\n      \"args\": [\"mcp-server\"],\n      \"env\": {\n        \"CODEX_WORKSPACE\": \"${workspaceFolder}\",\n        \"RUST_LOG\": \"info\",\n        \"CODEX_MODE\": \"research\"\n      },\n      \"description\": \"Deep research with multi-source validation and citations\"\n    }\n  },\n  \"tools\": {\n    \"codex-subagent\": {\n      \"available_agents\": [\n        \"researcher\",\n        \"code-reviewer\",\n        \"test-gen\",\n        \"sec-audit\",\n        \"python-reviewer\",\n        \"ts-reviewer\",\n        \"unity-reviewer\"\n      ],\n      \"usage\": \"@code-reviewer Review this code for best practices\"\n    },\n    \"codex-deep-research\": {\n      \"parameters\": {\n        \"depth\": \"1-5 (default: 3)\",\n        \"max_sources\": \"3-20 (default: 10)\",\n        \"strategy\": \"comprehensive|focused|exploratory (default: comprehensive)\"\n      },\n      \"usage\": concatenate)\"\n      },\n      \"usage\": \"@supervisor Coordinate code review and testing\"\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "# 🔧 Codex MCP Configuration Guide\n\n**Version**: codex-cli 0.47.0-alpha.1  \n**Last Updated**: 2025-10-12  \n**Configuration File**: &#96;~/.cursor/mcp.json&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 📋 Overview\n\nThis guide explains how to configure the Codex MCP (Model Context Protocol) server in Cursor IDE to leverage the production-ready meta-orchestration features.\n\n---\n\n## ⚙️ Configuration\n\n### Full &#96;mcp.json&#96; Entry\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"mcpServers\": {\n    \"codex\": {\n      \"command\": \"codex\",\n      \"args\": [\"mcp-server\"],\n      \"env\": {\n        \"RUST_LOG\": \"info\",\n        \"CODEX_CONFIG_PATH\": \"C:\\\\Users\\\\&lt;username&gt;\\\\.codex\\\\config.toml\"\n      },\n      \"description\": \"Codex MCP Server v0.47.0-alpha.1 - Production-Ready Meta-Orchestration System\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🛠️ Available Tools\n\n### 1. &#96;codex&#96;\n**Description**: Execute Codex with full capabilities\n\n**CLI Equivalent**: &#96;codex &lt;prompt&gt;&#96;\n\n**Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"tool\": \"codex\",\n  \"arguments\": {\n    \"prompt\": \"Implement user authentication with JWT\",\n    \"config\": {\n      \"model\": \"o3\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 2. &#96;codex-reply&#96;\n**Description**: Continue existing Codex conversation\n\n**Parameters**:\n- &#96;conversationId&#96; (string): Conversation ID to continue\n- &#96;prompt&#96; (string): Next user prompt\n\n**Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"tool\": \"codex-reply\",\n  \"arguments\": {\n    \"conversationId\": \"conv-abc123\",\n    \"prompt\": \"Now add password reset functionality\"\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 3. &#96;codex-supervisor&#96;\n**Description**: Coordinate multiple specialized AI agents\n\n**Parameters**:\n- &#96;goal&#96; (string): High-level goal to accomplish\n- &#96;agents&#96; (array, optional): Specific agent types to use\n- &#96;strategy&#96; (string, optional): Coordination strategy (&#96;sequential&#96;, &#96;parallel&#96;, &#96;hybrid&#96;)\n- &#96;merge_strategy&#96; (string, optional): Result merging (&#96;concatenate&#96;, &#96;voting&#96;, &#96;highest_score&#96;)\n\n**Available Agents**:\n- &#96;CodeExpert&#96; - Code implementation and refactoring\n- &#96;Researcher&#96; - Technology research and best practices\n- &#96;Tester&#96; - Test generation and coverage analysis\n- &#96;Security&#96; - Security audits and vulnerability scanning\n- &#96;Backend&#96; - Backend architecture and APIs",

        "contents": "# 🔧 Codex MCP Configuration Guide\n\n**Version**: codex-cli 0.47.0-alpha.1  \n**Last Updated**: 2025-10-12  \n**Configuration File**: &#96;~/.cursor/mcp.json&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 📋 Overview\n\nThis guide explains how to configure the Codex MCP (Model Context Protocol) server in Cursor IDE to leverage the production-ready meta-orchestration features.\n\n---\n\n## ⚙️ Configuration\n\n### Full &#96;mcp.json&#96; Entry\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"mcpServers\": {\n    \"codex\": {\n      \"command\": \"codex\",\n      \"args\": [\"mcp-server\"],\n      \"env\": {\n        \"RUST_LOG\": \"info\",\n        \"CODEX_CONFIG_PATH\": \"C:\\\\Users\\\\&lt;username&gt;\\\\.codex\\\\config.toml\"\n      },\n      \"description\": \"Codex MCP Server v0.47.0-alpha.1 - Production-Ready Meta-Orchestration System\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🛠️ Available Tools\n\n### 1. &#96;codex&#96;\n**Description**: Execute Codex with full capabilities\n\n**CLI Equivalent**: &#96;codex &lt;prompt&gt;&#96;\n\n**Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"tool\": \"codex\",\n  \"arguments\": {\n    \"prompt\": \"Implement user authentication with JWT\",\n    \"config\": {\n      \"model\": \"o3\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 2. &#96;codex-reply&#96;\n**Description**: Continue existing Codex conversation\n\n**Parameters**:\n- &#96;conversationId&#96; (string): Conversation ID to continue\n- &#96;prompt&#96; (string): Next user prompt\n\n**Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"tool\": \"codex-reply\",\n  \"arguments\": {\n    \"conversationId\": \"conv-abc123\",\n    \"prompt\": \"Now add password reset functionality\"\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 3. &#96;codex-supervisor&#96;\n**Description**: Coordinate multiple specialized AI agents\n\n**Parameters**:\n- &#96;goal&#96; (string): High-level goal to accomplish\n- &#96;agents&#96; (array, optional): Specific agent types to use\n- &#96;strategy&#96; (string, optional): Coordination strategy (&#96;sequential&#96;, &#96;parallel&#96;, &#96;hybrid&#96;)\n- &#96;merge_strategy&#96; (string, optional): Result merging (&#96;concatenate&#96;, &#96;voting&#96;, &#96;highest_score&#96;)\n\n**Available Agents**:\n- &#96;CodeExpert&#96; - Code implementation and refactoring\n- &#96;Researcher&#96; - Technology research and best practices\n- &#96;Tester&#96; - Test generation and coverage analysis\n- &#96;Security&#96; - Security audits and vulnerability scanning\n- &#96;Backend&#96; - Backend architecture and APIs",

        "contents": "use crate::client_common::tools::ToolSpec;\nuse crate::error::Result;\nuse crate::models_manager::model_family::ModelFamily;\npub use codex_api::common::ResponseEvent;\nuse codex_apply_patch::APPLY_PATCH_TOOL_INSTRUCTIONS;\nuse codex_protocol::models::ResponseItem;\nuse futures::Stream;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde_json::Value;\nuse std::borrow::Cow;\nuse std::collections::HashSet;\nuse std::ops::Deref;\nuse std::pin::Pin;\nuse std::task::Context;\nuse std::task::Poll;\nuse tokio::sync::mpsc;\n\n/// Review thread system prompt.         "contents": "// Hook MCP Tool Definition\nuse mcp_types::Tool;\nuse mcp_types::ToolInputSchema;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse serde_json::json;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct HookToolParam {\n    /// Hook event type\n    pub event: String,\n\n    /// Optional context\n    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub context: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\npub fn create_hook_tool() -&gt; Tool {\n    Tool {\n        name: \"codex-hook\".to_string(),\n        title: Some(\"Hook Tool\".to_string()),\n        description: Some(\"Execute hooks for lifecycle events. Available events: on_task_start, on_task_complete, on_error, on_task_abort, on_subagent_start, on_subagent_complete, on_session_start, on_session_end, on_patch_apply, on_command_exec\".to_string()),\n        input_schema: ToolInputSchema {\n            r#type: \"object\".to_string(),\n            properties: Some(json!({\n                \"event\": {\n                    \"type\": \"string\",\n                    \"description\": \"Hook event to trigger\",\n                    \"enum\": [\n                        \"on_task_start\",\n                        \"on_task_complete\",\n                        \"on_error\",\n                        \"on_task_abort\",\n                        \"on_subagent_start\",\n                        \"on_subagent_complete\",\n                        \"on_session_start\",\n                        \"on_session_end\",\n                        \"on_patch_apply\",\n                        \"on_command_exec\"\n                    ]\n                },\n                \"context\": {\n                    \"type\": \"string\",\n                    \"description\": \"Optional context information for the hook\"\n                }\n            })),\n            required: Some(vec![\"event\".to_string()]),\n        },\n        output_schema: None,\n        annotations: None,\n    }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "# @openai/codex-shell-tool-mcp\n\n**Note: This MCP server is still experimental. When using it with Codex CLI, ensure the CLI version matches the MCP server version.**\n\n&#96;@openai/codex-shell-tool-mcp&#96; is an MCP server that provides a tool named &#96;shell&#96; that runs a shell command inside a sandboxed instance of Bash. This special instance of Bash intercepts requests to spawn new processes (specifically, [&#96;execve(2)&#96;](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/execve.2.html) calls). For each call, it makes a request back to the MCP server to determine whether to allow the proposed command to execute. It also has the option of _escalating_ the command to run unprivileged outside of the sandbox governing the Bash process.\n\nThe user can use [Codex &#96;.rules&#96;](https://developers.openai.com/codex/local-config#rules-preview) files to define how a command should be handled. The action to take is determined by the &#96;decision&#96; parameter of a matching rule as follows:\n\n- &#96;allow&#96;: the command will be _escalated_ and run outside the sandbox\n- &#96;prompt&#96;: the command will be subject to human approval via an [MCP elicitation](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/client/elicitation) (it will run _escalated_ if approved)\n- &#96;forbidden&#96;: the command will fail with exit code &#96;1&#96; and an error message will be written to &#96;stderr&#96;\n\nCommands that do not match an explicit rule in &#96;.rules&#96; will be allowed to run as-is, though they will still be subject to the sandbox applied to the parent Bash process.\n\n## Motivation\n\nWhen a software agent asks if it is safe to run a command like &#96;ls&#96;, without more context, it is unclear whether it will result in executing &#96;/bin/ls&#96;. Consider:\n\n- There could be another executable named &#96;ls&#96; that appears before &#96;/bin/ls&#96; on the &#96;$PATH&#96;.\n- &#96;ls&#96; could be mapped to a shell alias or function.\n\nBecause &#96;@openai/codex-shell-tool-mcp&#96; intercepts &#96;execve(2)&#96; calls directly, it _always_ knows the full path to the program being executed. In turn, this makes it possible to provide stronger guarantees on how [Codex &#96;.rules&#96;](https://developers.openai.com/codex/local-config#rules-preview) are enforced.\n\n## Usage\n\nFirst, verify that you can download and run the MCP executable:",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "//! Codex-specific MCP tools for sub-agent delegation\n//!\n//! These tools allow sub-agents to call Codex capabilities via MCP protocol.\n\nuse serde_json::Value;\n\n// Tool implementations\nmod apply_patch;\nmod codebase_search;\nmod grep;\nmod read_file;\nmod shell;\n\n#[cfg(feature = \"cuda\")]\npub mod cuda;\n\n/// Codex MCP tool definitions for sub-agents\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct CodexMcpTool {\n    pub name: String,\n    pub description: String,\n    pub input_schema: Value,\n}\n\nimpl CodexMcpTool {\n    /// Get all safe (read-only) tools\n    pub fn safe_tools() -&gt; Vec&lt;Self&gt; {\n        vec![Self::read_file(), Self::grep(), Self::codebase_search()]\n    }\n\n    /// Get all tools (including write/shell)\n    pub fn all_tools() -&gt; Vec&lt;Self&gt; {\n        let base_tools = vec![\n            Self::read_file(),\n            Self::grep(),\n            Self::codebase_search(),\n            Self::apply_patch(),\n            Self::shell(),\n        ];\n\n        #[cfg(feature = \"cuda\")]\n        {\n            let mut tools = base_tools;\n            tools.push(Self::cuda_execute());\n            tools\n        }\n\n        #[cfg(not(feature = \"cuda\"))]\n        {\n            base_tools\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// CUDA GPU acceleration tool\n    #[cfg(feature = \"cuda\")]\n    pub fn cuda_execute() -&gt; Self {\n        use serde_json::json;",

        "contents": "// Custom Command Tool Handler\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse mcp_types::CallToolResult;\nuse mcp_types::ContentBlock;\nuse mcp_types::TextContent;\nuse serde_json::Value;\n\nuse crate::custom_command_tool::CustomCommandToolParam;\n\npub async fn handle_custom_command_tool_call(arguments: Value) -&gt; Result&lt;CallToolResult&gt; {\n    let params: CustomCommandToolParam = serde_json::from_value(arguments)?;\n\n    let response_text = match params.action.as_str() {\n        \"execute\" =&gt; {\n            let command_name = params\n                .command_name\n                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!(\"command_name required for execute\"))?;\n            let context = params\n                .context\n                .unwrap_or_else(|| \"No context provided\".to_string());\n\n            let (subagent, description) = match command_name.as_str() {\n                \"analyze_code\" =&gt; (\"CodeExpert\", \"Analyzing code for bugs and improvements\"),\n                \"security_review\" =&gt; (\"SecurityExpert\", \"Performing security review\"),\n                \"generate_tests\" =&gt; (\"TestingExpert\", \"Generating test suite\"),\n                \"deep_research\" =&gt; (\"DeepResearcher\", \"Conducting deep research\"),\n                \"debug_issue\" =&gt; (\"DebugExpert\", \"Debugging and fixing issues\"),\n                \"optimize_performance\" =&gt; (\"PerformanceExpert\", \"Optimizing performance\"),\n                \"generate_docs\" =&gt; (\"DocsExpert\", \"Generating documentation\"),\n                _ =&gt; (\"General\", \"Processing custom command\"),\n            };\n\n            format!(\n                \"[CustomCommand] Executing: {command_name}\\n\\n\\\n                Dispatching to subagent: {subagent}\\n\\\n                Description: {description}\\n\\n\\\n                Context:\\n{context}\\n\\n\\\n                The {subagent} subagent will process this request asynchronously.\\n\\\n                Use the 'codex-subagent' tool with action 'check_inbox' to see results.\"\n            )\n        }\n        \"list\" =&gt; \"Available Custom Commands (7):\\n\\n\\\n            1. analyze_code → CodeExpert",

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"name: \\\"sec-audit\\\"\\ngoal: \\\"Security audit with CVE scanning, dependency analysis, and vulnerability patching\\\"\\ninstructions: |\\n  You are a security audit specialist. Your role is to identify and remediate security vulnerabilities.\\n  \\n  Security audit process:\\n  1. **Dependency Scanning**:\\n     - Run cargo-audit (Rust), npm audit (Node.js), pip-audit (Python)\\n     - Check against CVE databases (NVD, MITRE, RustSec)\\n     - Identify outdated dependencies\\n  \\n  2. **Code Analysis**:\\n     - SQL Injection: Look for raw SQL queries, unsanitized inputs\\n     - XSS: Check for unescaped HTML rendering\\n     - CSRF: Verify token validation\\n     - Authentication: Check for weak password policies, insecure session management\\n     - Secrets: Scan for hardcoded API keys, passwords, tokens\\n     - Unsafe code: Review use of unsafe blocks (Rust), eval/exec (Python/JS)\\n  \\n  3. **Reporting**:\\n     - Prioritize findings: Critical &amp;gt; High &amp;gt; Medium &amp;gt; Low\\n     - For each vulnerability:\\n       * Describe the issue and impact\\n       * Provide file path and line number\\n       * Suggest remediation with code example\\n       * Include CVE references if applicable\\n       * Recommend dependency version upgrades\\n  \\n  Generate actionable security reports with clear remediation steps.\\ntools:\\n  mcp:\\n    - grep\\n    - read_file\\n    - codebase_search\\n    - web_search\\n  fs:\\n    read: true\\n    write:\\n      - \\\"./artifacts\\\"\\n      - \\\"./security-reports\\\"\\n  net:\\n    allow:\\n      - \\\"https://nvd.nist.gov/*\\\"\\n      - \\\"https://cve.mitre.org/*\\\"\\n      - \\\"https://rustsec.org/*\\\"\\n      - \\\"https://snyk.io/*\\\"\\n      - \\\"https://github.com/advisories/*\\\"\\n  shell:\\n    exec:\\n      - cargo\\n      - npm\\n      - pip\\n      - cargo-audit\\n      - npm audit\\npolicies:\\n  context:\\n    max_tokens: 50000\\n    retention: \\\"session\\\"\\n  secrets:\\n    redact: true\\nsuccess_criteria:\\n  - \\\"Scan all dependencies for known CVEs\\\"\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 17433,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"    pub async fn start_tool_process(\\n        &amp;amp;self,\\n        tool: &amp;amp;AITool,\\n        task_id: &amp;amp;str,\\n        task_description: &amp;amp;str,\\n        working_directory: Option&amp;lt;&amp;amp;str&amp;gt;,\\n    ) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;tokio::process::Child, Box&amp;lt;dyn std::error::Error&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n        let mut command = tokio::process::Command::new(&amp;amp;tool.command[0]);\\n\\n        // Add remaining command arguments\\n        for arg in &amp;amp;tool.command[1..] {\\n            command.arg(arg);\\n        }\\n\\n        // Set working directory\\n        if let Some(cwd) = working_directory.or(tool.working_directory.as_deref()) {\\n            command.current_dir(cwd);\\n        }\\n\\n        // Set environment variables\\n        for (key, value) in &amp;amp;tool.environment_variables {\\n            command.env(key, value);\\n        }\\n\\n        // Configure process\\n        command\\n            .stdin(Stdio::piped())\\n            .stdout(Stdio::piped())\\n            .stderr(Stdio::piped());\\n\\n        let child = command.spawn()?;\\n\\n        // Send initial task description if stdin is available\\n        if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {\\n            let input = format!(\\\"{}\\\\n\\\", task_description);\\n            let _ = tokio::io::AsyncWriteExt::write_all(&amp;amp;mut stdin, input.as_bytes()).await;\\n        }\\n\\n        Ok(child)\\n    }\\n\\n    fn calculate_quality_score\","
                },

                {
                  "lineNumber": 24389,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# ====================\\n# Codex Environment Variables Template\\n# ====================\\n# 📋 使い方 / Usage:\\n#   1. このファイルを .env にコピー: copy env.template .env\\n#   2. 各環境変数に実際の値を設定\\n#   3. .env ファイルは公開しないこと（.gitignoreに追加済み）\\n\\n# ====================\\n# 🔑 OpenAI API (REQUIRED)\\n# ====================\\n# OpenAI APIキー（必須）\\n# 取得方法: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys\\n# \\n# 注意: sk-proj- で始まるProject APIキーを使用してください\\nOPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-YOUR_API_KEY_HERE\\n\\n# ====================\\n# 🐙 GitHub Integration (REQUIRED)\\n# ====================\\n# GitHub Personal Access Token（必須）\\n# 取得方法: https://github.com/settings/tokens\\n# \\n# 必要なスコープ:\\n#   - repo: フルリポジトリアクセス\\n#   - read:org: 組織情報の読み取り\\n#   - workflow: GitHub Actionsワークフローの管理\\n#   - gist: Gistの作成・管理（オプション）\\nGITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN_HERE\\n\\n# ====================\\n# 📢 Slack Integration (OPTIONAL)\\n# ====================\\n# Slack Webhook URL（オプション - タスク完了通知用）\\n# 取得方法: https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks\\n# \\n# セットアップ手順:\\n#   1. Slack Appを作成\\n#   2. Incoming Webhooksを有効化\\n#   3. Webhook URLを取得\\n#   4. 以下に設定\\nSLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=https://hooks.slack.com/services/YOUR/WEBHOOK/URL\\n\\n# ====================\\n# 🔍 Brave Search (OPTIONAL)\\n# ====================\\n# Brave Search API Key（オプション）\\n# 取得方法: https://api.search.brave.com/\\n# \\n# 注意: 現在config.tomlで disabled=true に設定されています\\n#       使用する場合は config.toml の [mcp_servers.brave-search] の\\n#       disabled = true 行を削除してください\\nBRAVE_API_KEY=YOUR_BRAVE_API_KEY_HERE\\n\\n# ====================\\n# ☁️ Upstash Context7 (OPTIONAL)\\n# ====================\\n# Upstash Redis REST API（オプション - コンテキスト管理用）\","
                },

Webhook URLを取得\\n#   4. 以下に設定\\nSLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=https://hooks.slack.com/services/YOUR/WEBHOOK/URL\\n\\n# ====================\\n# 🔍 Brave Search (OPTIONAL)\\n# ====================\\n# Brave Search API Key（オプション）\\n# 取得方法: https://api.search.brave.com/\\n# \\n# 注意: 現在config.tomlで disabled=true に設定されています\\n#       使用する場合は config.toml の [mcp_servers.brave-search] の\\n#       disabled = true 行を削除してください\\nBRAVE_API_KEY=YOUR_BRAVE_API_KEY_HERE\\n\\n# ====================\\n# ☁️ Upstash Context7 (OPTIONAL)\\n# ====================\\n# Upstash Redis REST API（オプション - コンテキスト管理用）\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 26226,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# Codex v2.0.0 Environment Variables Sample\\n# このファイルを .env にコピーして実際の値を設定してください\\n\\n# ==================== 必須（Required） ====================\\n\\n# OpenAI API Key - メインのLLM接続に必要\\n# 取得方法: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys\\nOPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-your-api-key-here\\n\\n# ==================== オプション（Optional） ====================\\n\\n# GitHub Personal Access Token - GitHub MCP Server、コード連携用\\n# 取得方法: https://github.com/settings/tokens\\n# 権限: repo, read:org\\nGITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_your_github_token_here\\n\\n# Slack Webhook URL - 通知・監視用\\n# 取得方法: https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks\\nSLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=https://hooks.slack.com/services/YOUR/WEBHOOK/URL\\n\\n# Brave Search API Key - Web検索用（Deep Research）\\n# 取得方法: https://brave.com/search/api/\\nBRAVE_API_KEY=your_brave_api_key_here\\n\\n# ==================== GPU加速（GPU Acceleration） ====================\\n\\n# CUDA Device ID - 使用するGPUデバイス番号（デフォルト: 0）\\nCUDA_DEVICE=0\\n\\n# ==================== ログ・デバッグ（Logging &amp;amp; Debug） ====================\\n\\n# Rust Log Level - ログレベル設定\\nRUST_LOG=info\\n\\n# ==================== 使用例（Usage Examples） ====================\\n\\n# CUDA加速:\\n#   codex --use-cuda \\\"Analyze codebase\\\"\\n#\\n# Windows AI加速:\\n#   codex --use-windows-ai \\\"Your task\\\"\\n#\\n# git解析（CUDA、100,000コミット）:\\n#   codex git-analyze commits --use-cuda --limit 100000\","

計画を更新し、**MCPツールの動的ロード機能**に**トークン節約機能**を追加しました。

## 追加されたトークン節約機能

### 1. **McpTokenOptimizer**（トークン最適化マネージャー）
- ツール使用頻度の追跡
- 使用頻度の低いツールの自動アンロード
- ツール説明の圧縮・要約
- トークン使用量の監視とレポート

### 2. **SelectiveToolLoader**（選択的ツールローダー）
- タスク分析に基づくツール選択
- 必要なツールのみを動的にロード
- タスク完了後の自動アンロード

### 3. **McpPromptBuilder**（プロンプトビルダー）
- プロンプト構築時に必要なツールのみを追加
- ツール説明の圧縮
- トークン予算に基づくツール選択

## トークン節約戦略

1. **使用頻度ベースの自動アンロード**: 一定期間使用されていないツールを自動アンロード
2. **タスクベースの選択的ロード**: タスクに必要なツールのみをロード
3. **ツール説明の圧縮**: 長い説明を要約し、トークン数を50-70%削減
4. **プロンプトへの選択的追加**: タスクに関連するツールのみをプロンプトに追加
5. **トークン使用量の監視**: 各ツールのトークン消費を追跡・レポート

        "contents": "notify = \"6.1\"\nnotify-debouncer-full = \"0.3\"\nrusqlite = { version = \"0.32\", features = [\"bundled\"] }\nchrono = \"0.4\"\nwindows = { version = \"0.58\", ... }\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 1.3 システムトレイ統合\n\n**実装箇所**: &#96;src-tauri/src/tray.rs&#96; (100行)\n\n**機能**:\n- ✅ トレイアイコン表示\n- ✅ コンテキストメニュー（Dashboard/Settings/Docs/Quit）\n- ✅ ステータス表示（ファイル監視/Core状態）\n- ✅ 左クリック：ウィンドウ表示/非表示\n- ✅ 右クリック：メニュー表示\n\n**メニュー構成**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n📊 Dashboardを開く\n────────────────\n✅ ファイル監視: ON\n🔄 Codex Core: 起動中\n────────────────\n⚙️ Settings\n📖 Docs\n❌ Quit\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 1.4 ファイルシステム監視\n\n**実装箇所**: &#96;src-tauri/src/watcher.rs&#96; (163行)\n\n**使用ライブラリ**: &#96;notify&#96; + &#96;notify-debouncer-full&#96;\n\n**機能**:\n- ✅ ワークスペースディレクトリ監視\n- ✅ 300msデバウンス処理\n- ✅ &#96;.rs&#96;, &#96;.ts&#96;, &#96;.py&#96;, &#96;.md&#96;, &#96;.json&#96;等のフィルター\n- ✅ ファイル作成/変更/削除イベント検知\n- ✅ Diff計算（行数カウント）\n- ✅ Frontend通知（Tauri Event）\n- ✅ デスクトップ通知（50行以上変更時）\n\n**イベント処理フロー**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nFile Change → Debounce (300ms) → Filter → Diff Calc → DB Insert → Frontend Notify → Desktop Notify\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 1.5 変更履歴トラッキング\n\n**実装箇所**: &#96;src-tauri/src/db.rs&#96; (113行)\n\n**データベース**: SQLite (&#96;%APPDATA%\\codex\\codex.db&#96;)\n\n**スキーマ**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE file_changes (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    file_path TEXT NOT NULL,\n    change_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n    diff_lines_added INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    diff_lines_removed INTEGER DEFAULT 0\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX idx_timestamp ON file_changes(timestamp DESC);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**API**:\n- &#96;insert_change()&#96; - 変更記録挿入\n- &#96;get_recent_changes(limit)&#96; - 最近の変更取得\n- &#96;get_statistics()&#96; - 統計情報取得\n\n### 1.6 自動起動",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\.cursor\\plans\\os-resident-035d7493.plan.md",

          }
        },
        "contents": "# Bundler: Vite\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**主要ファイル**:\n\n- &#96;src-tauri/Cargo.toml&#96; - Rust依存関係\n- &#96;src-tauri/tauri.conf.json&#96; - Tauri設定\n- &#96;src-tauri/src/main.rs&#96; - エントリーポイント\n- &#96;src/&#96; - React frontend\n\n**依存関係追加**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n# Cargo.toml\ntauri = { version = \"2.0\", features = [\"system-tray\", \"notification\"] }\nnotify = \"6.1\"  # File system watcher\ntokio = { version = \"1.42\", features = [\"full\"] }\nserde = { version = \"1.0\", features = [\"derive\"] }\ncodex-core = { path = \"../codex-rs/core\" }  # 既存コア統合\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 1.2 システムトレイ統合\n\n**実装箇所**: &#96;src-tauri/src/tray.rs&#96;\n\n**機能**:\n\n- トレイアイコン表示（Codexロゴ）\n- コンテキストメニュー（Show/Hide, Start/Stop Monitoring, Quit）\n- 通知表示（ファイル変更検知時）\n- 左クリック: ウィンドウ表示/非表示\n- 右クリック: メニュー表示\n\n**メニュー構成**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────┐\n│ 📊 Dashboard を開く      │\n│ ───────────────────────  │\n│ ✅ ファイル監視: ON      │\n│ 🔄 Codex Core: 起動中    │\n│ ───────────────────────  │\n│ ⚙️ Settings              │\n│ 📖 Docs                  │\n│ ❌ Quit                  │\n└─────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 1.3 自動起動設定\n\n**実装箇所**: &#96;src-tauri/src/autostart.rs&#96;\n\n**機能**:\n\n- Windows起動時に自動起動\n- レジストリ登録: &#96;HKEY_CURRENT_USER\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run&#96;\n- UI設定でON/OFF切り替え可能\n\n## Phase 2: ファイルシステム監視\n\n### 2.1 Windows File System Watcher\n\n**実装箇所**: &#96;src-tauri/src/watcher.rs&#96;\n\n**使用ライブラリ**: &#96;notify&#96; (cross-platform, Windows backend: ReadDirectoryChangesW)\n\n**監視対象**:\n\n- ワークスペースディレクトリ（ユーザー指定）\n- &#96;.gitignore&#96; 尊重\n- フィルター: &#96;.rs&#96;, &#96;.ts&#96;, &#96;.py&#96;, &#96;.md&#96;, &#96;.toml&#96;, etc.",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# Bundler: Vite\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**主要ファイル**:\n\n- &#96;src-tauri/Cargo.toml&#96; - Rust依存関係\n- &#96;src-tauri/tauri.conf.json&#96; - Tauri設定\n- &#96;src-tauri/src/main.rs&#96; - エントリーポイント\n- &#96;src/&#96; - React frontend\n\n**依存関係追加**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n# Cargo.toml\ntauri = { version = \"2.0\", features = [\"system-tray\", \"notification\"] }\nnotify = \"6.1\"  # File system watcher\ntokio = { version = \"1.42\", features = [\"full\"] }\nserde = { version = \"1.0\", features = [\"derive\"] }\ncodex-core = { path = \"../codex-rs/core\" }  # 既存コア統合\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 1.2 システムトレイ統合\n\n**実装箇所**: &#96;src-tauri/src/tray.rs&#96;\n\n**機能**:\n\n- トレイアイコン表示（Codexロゴ）\n- コンテキストメニュー（Show/Hide, Start/Stop Monitoring, Quit）\n- 通知表示（ファイル変更検知時）\n- 左クリック: ウィンドウ表示/非表示\n- 右クリック: メニュー表示\n\n**メニュー構成**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────┐\n│ 📊 Dashboard を開く      │\n│ ───────────────────────  │\n│ ✅ ファイル監視: ON      │\n│ 🔄 Codex Core: 起動中    │\n│ ───────────────────────  │\n│ ⚙️ Settings              │\n│ 📖 Docs                  │\n│ ❌ Quit                  │\n└─────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 1.3 自動起動設定\n\n**実装箇所**: &#96;src-tauri/src/autostart.rs&#96;\n\n**機能**:\n\n- Windows起動時に自動起動\n- レジストリ登録: &#96;HKEY_CURRENT_USER\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run&#96;\n- UI設定でON/OFF切り替え可能\n\n## Phase 2: ファイルシステム監視\n\n### 2.1 Windows File System Watcher\n\n**実装箇所**: &#96;src-tauri/src/watcher.rs&#96;\n\n**使用ライブラリ**: &#96;notify&#96; (cross-platform, Windows backend: ReadDirectoryChangesW)\n\n**監視対象**:\n\n- ワークスペースディレクトリ（ユーザー指定）\n- &#96;.gitignore&#96; 尊重\n- フィルター: &#96;.rs&#96;, &#96;.ts&#96;, &#96;.py&#96;, &#96;.md&#96;, &#96;.toml&#96;, etc.",

        "contents": "pub mod fs_wait {\n    use anyhow::Result;\n    use anyhow::anyhow;\n    use notify::RecursiveMode;\n    use notify::Watcher;\n    use std::path::Path;\n    use std::path::PathBuf;\n    use std::sync::mpsc;\n    use std::sync::mpsc::RecvTimeoutError;\n    use std::time::Duration;\n    use std::time::Instant;\n    use tokio::task;\n    use walkdir::WalkDir;\n\n    pub async fn wait_for_path_exists(\n        path: impl Into&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n        timeout: Duration,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n        let path = path.into();\n        task::spawn_blocking(move || wait_for_path_exists_blocking(path, timeout)).await?\n    }\n\n    pub async fn wait_for_matching_file(\n        root: impl Into&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n        timeout: Duration,\n        predicate: impl FnMut(&amp;Path) -&gt; bool + Send + 'static,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n        let root = root.into();\n        task::spawn_blocking(move || {\n            let mut predicate = predicate;\n            blocking_find_matching_file(root, timeout, &amp;mut predicate)\n        })\n        .await?\n    }\n\n    fn wait_for_path_exists_blocking",

        "contents": "async fn main() -&gt; Result&lt;(), GuiError&gt; {\n    init_tracing();\n\n    let port = std::env::var(\"CODEX_GUI_PORT\")\n        .ok()\n        .and_then(|raw| raw.parse::&lt;u16&gt;().ok())\n        .unwrap_or(8787);\n\n    let cli_path = std::env::var(\"CODEX_GUI_CLI_PATH\").unwrap_or_else(|_| \"codex\".to_string());\n\n    let state = AppState::new(cli_path, action_definitions());\n    let cli_path_for_log = state.cli_path.clone();\n\n    let app = Router::new()\n        .route(\"/api/actions\", get(list_actions))\n        .route(\"/api/actions/{id}/execute\", post(execute_action))\n        .route(\"/api/mcp/connections\", get(list_mcp_connections))\n        .route(\"/api/system/metrics\", get(get_system_metrics))\n        .route(\"/api/conversations\", get(list_conversations))\n        .route(\"/api/conversations\", post(create_conversation))\n        .route(\"/api/conversations/{id}/messages\", get(get_messages))\n        .route(\"/api/conversations/{id}/messages\", post(send_message))\n        .route(\"/api/user\", get(get_current_user))\n        .with_state(state)\n        .layer(\n            CorsLayer::new()\n                .allow_methods([Method::GET, Method::POST])\n                .allow_headers(Any)\n                .allow_origin(Any),\n        )\n        .layer(TraceLayer::new_for_http());\n\n    let addr = SocketAddr::from(([0, 0, 0, 0], port));\n    let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr).await.map_err(GuiError::from)?;\n\n    info!(\n        port,\n        cli_path = cli_path_for_log.as_str(),\n        \"listening on http://0.0.0.0:{port}\"\n    );\n\n    let server = axum::serve(listener, app).with_graceful_shutdown(shutdown_signal());\n\n    server.await.map_err(GuiError::from)\n}\n\nfn init_tracing() {\n    let filter = std::env::var(\"RUST_LOG\").unwrap_or_else(|_| \"info\".to_string());\n\n    tracing_subscriber::fmt()\n        .with_env_filter(filter)\n        .with_target(false)\n        .compact()\n        .init();\n}\n\nasync fn shutdown_signal() {\n    let ctrl_c =",

        "contents": "# Codex Cloud API設計書\n\n**バージョン**: v1.0.0  \n**最終更新**: 2025年11月2日  \n**目的**: Codex Cloud SaaS APIの完全な設計仕様\n\n---\n\n## 📋 目次\n\n1. [アーキテクチャ概要](#architecture)\n2. [認証 &amp; 認可](#auth)\n3. [エージェント実行](#agents)\n4. [可視化エンドポイント](#visualization)\n5. [サブスクリプション管理](#subscription)\n6. [WebSocket](#websocket)\n7. [Rate Limiting](#rate-limiting)\n8. [エラーハンドリング](#errors)\n\n---\n\n## &lt;a name=\"architecture\"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;🏗️ アーキテクチャ概要\n\n### スタック\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nClient (Browser/IDE/CLI)\n    ↓ HTTPS/WSS\n[ API Gateway - AWS ALB/CloudFlare ]\n    ↓\n[ Rust Backend - axum ]\n    ├── Authentication (JWT + Auth0)\n    ├── Agent Orchestrator\n    ├── Visualization Service\n    └── Subscription Manager\n    ↓\n[ GPU Cluster - Kubernetes ]\n[ PostgreSQL - User data ]\n[ Redis - Session/Cache ]\n[ S3 - Artifacts ]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Base URL\n\n- **Production**: &#96;https://api.codex.ai&#96;\n- **Staging**: &#96;https://api-staging.codex.ai&#96;\n- **Development**: &#96;http://localhost:8080&#96;\n\n### API Versioning\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nhttps://api.codex.ai/v1/{endpoint}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Content Type\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nContent-Type: application/json\nAccept: application/json\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## &lt;a name=\"auth\"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;🔐 認証 &amp; 認可\n\n### 認証フロー\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nsequenceDiagram\n    Client-&gt;&gt;+Auth0: Login (email/password)\n    Auth0-&gt;&gt;+Client: ID Token (JWT)\n    Client-&gt;&gt;+Codex API: Request + Authorization header\n    Codex API-&gt;&gt;+Auth0: Validate token\n    Auth0-&gt;&gt;+Codex API: User info\n    Codex API-&gt;&gt;+Client: Response\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### JWT Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"sub\": \"auth0|507f1f77bcf86cd799439011\",\n  \"email\": \"user@example.com\",\n  \"email_verified\": true,\n  \"iss\": \"https://codex.auth0.com/\",\n  \"aud\": \"https://api.codex.ai\",\n  \"iat\": 1699999999,\n  \"exp\": 1700086399,\n  \"azp\": \"CLIENT_ID\",\n  \"scope\": \"openid profile email\",\n  \"codex_tier\": \"pro\",\n  \"codex_subscription_id\": \"sub_1ABC...\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### API Key (Alternative)\n\nFor CLI/automation:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex Cloud API設計書",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**バージョン**: v1.0.0  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**最終更新**: 2025年11月2日  ",
            "lineNumber": 4

        "contents": "# Codex Cloud API設計書\n\n**バージョン**: v1.0.0  \n**最終更新**: 2025年11月2日  \n**目的**: Codex Cloud SaaS APIの完全な設計仕様\n\n---\n\n## 📋 目次\n\n1. [アーキテクチャ概要](#architecture)\n2. [認証 &amp; 認可](#auth)\n3. [エージェント実行](#agents)\n4. [可視化エンドポイント](#visualization)\n5. [サブスクリプション管理](#subscription)\n6. [WebSocket](#websocket)\n7. [Rate Limiting](#rate-limiting)\n8. [エラーハンドリング](#errors)\n\n---\n\n## &lt;a name=\"architecture\"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;🏗️ アーキテクチャ概要\n\n### スタック\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nClient (Browser/IDE/CLI)\n    ↓ HTTPS/WSS\n[ API Gateway - AWS ALB/CloudFlare ]\n    ↓\n[ Rust Backend - axum ]\n    ├── Authentication (JWT + Auth0)\n    ├── Agent Orchestrator\n    ├── Visualization Service\n    └── Subscription Manager\n    ↓\n[ GPU Cluster - Kubernetes ]\n[ PostgreSQL - User data ]\n[ Redis - Session/Cache ]\n[ S3 - Artifacts ]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Base URL\n\n- **Production**: &#96;https://api.codex.ai&#96;\n- **Staging**: &#96;https://api-staging.codex.ai&#96;\n- **Development**: &#96;http://localhost:8080&#96;\n\n### API Versioning\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nhttps://api.codex.ai/v1/{endpoint}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Content Type\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nContent-Type: application/json\nAccept: application/json\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## &lt;a name=\"auth\"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;🔐 認証 &amp; 認可\n\n### 認証フロー\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nsequenceDiagram\n    Client-&gt;&gt;+Auth0: Login (email/password)\n    Auth0-&gt;&gt;+Client: ID Token (JWT)\n    Client-&gt;&gt;+Codex API: Request + Authorization header\n    Codex API-&gt;&gt;+Auth0: Validate token\n    Auth0-&gt;&gt;+Codex API: User info\n    Codex API-&gt;&gt;+Client: Response\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### JWT Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"sub\": \"auth0|507f1f77bcf86cd799439011\",\n  \"email\": \"user@example.com\",\n  \"email_verified\": true,\n  \"iss\": \"https://codex.auth0.com/\",\n  \"aud\": \"https://api.codex.ai\",\n  \"iat\": 1699999999,\n  \"exp\": 1700086399,\n  \"azp\": \"CLIENT_ID\",\n  \"scope\": \"openid profile email\",\n  \"codex_tier\": \"pro\",\n  \"codex_subscription_id\": \"sub_1ABC...\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### API Key (Alternative)\n\nFor CLI/automation:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "# Codex Viz Backend\n\nRust backend server for Kamui4d-style repository visualization.\n\n## Features\n\n- **REST API** for git repository analysis\n  - &#96;GET /api/commits&#96; - 3D commit history\n  - &#96;GET /api/files/heatmap&#96; - File change statistics\n  - &#96;GET /api/branches/graph&#96; - Branch structure\n- **WebSocket** for real-time updates (&#96;/api/realtime&#96;)\n- **Git Analysis Engine** with 3D coordinate calculation\n- **File System Watcher** for live monitoring\n\n## Development\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Build\ncargo build\n\n# Run\ncargo run\n\n# Server will start on http://127.0.0.1:3001\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## API Examples\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Get commits\ncurl \"http://localhost:3001/api/commits?limit=100\"\n\n# Get file heatmap\ncurl \"http://localhost:3001/api/files/heatmap\"\n\n# Get branch graph\ncurl \"http://localhost:3001/api/branches/graph\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## WebSocket\n\nConnect to &#96;ws://localhost:3001/api/realtime&#96; for real-time git events.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex Viz Backend",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "Rust backend server for Kamui4d-style repository visualization.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## Features",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- **REST API** for git repository analysis",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;GET /api/commits&#96; - 3D commit history",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;GET /api/files/heatmap&#96; - File change statistics",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;GET /api/branches/graph&#96; - Branch structure",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- **WebSocket** for real-time updates (&#96;/api/realtime&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Git Analysis Engine** with 3D coordinate calculation",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- **File System Watcher** for live monitoring",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "## Development",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "# Build",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo build",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "# Run",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo run",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "# Server will start on http://127.0.0.1:3001",
            "lineNumber": 24

        "contents": "# Codex Viz Backend\n\nRust backend server for Kamui4d-style repository visualization.\n\n## Features\n\n- **REST API** for git repository analysis\n  - &#96;GET /api/commits&#96; - 3D commit history\n  - &#96;GET /api/files/heatmap&#96; - File change statistics\n  - &#96;GET /api/branches/graph&#96; - Branch structure\n- **WebSocket** for real-time updates (&#96;/api/realtime&#96;)\n- **Git Analysis Engine** with 3D coordinate calculation\n- **File System Watcher** for live monitoring\n\n## Development\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Build\ncargo build\n\n# Run\ncargo run\n\n# Server will start on http://127.0.0.1:3001\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## API Examples\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Get commits\ncurl \"http://localhost:3001/api/commits?limit=100\"\n\n# Get file heatmap\ncurl \"http://localhost:3001/api/files/heatmap\"\n\n# Get branch graph\ncurl \"http://localhost:3001/api/branches/graph\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## WebSocket\n\nConnect to &#96;ws://localhost:3001/api/realtime&#96; for real-time git events.",

        "contents": "# GUI/CLI接続実装完了\n\n**日時**: 2025-11-21 17:00:38\n**タスク**: モックアップ実装のGUIをCLIと本接続するよう修正\n**バージョン**: 2.3.0 (v2.2.0安定版ベース + MCP統合 + GUI-CLI接続)\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 問題解決\n\n**元の問題**: GUIがモックアップ実装で、CLIとの接続ができていない\n\n**根本原因**:\n- GUIのAPIクライアントが &#96;http://localhost:8787&#96; の存在しないエンドポイントを呼び出し\n- プロトコルクライアントを使用せず、ハードコードされたモックレスポンスを返却\n- CLIにRPCサーバー機能が実装されていない\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 実装内容\n\n### 1. CLIにRPCサーバー機能追加\n\n**追加ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/main.rs&#96;\n\n**新機能**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nfn launch_server() -&gt; Result&lt;(), Box&lt;dyn std::error::Error&gt;&gt; {\n    // WebSocketベースRPCサーバー（ポート3001）\n    let listener = TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:3001\").await?;\n    println!(\"RPC Server listening on ws://127.0.0.1:3001\");\n    // ... WebSocket接続処理\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**依存関係追加**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\ntokio-tungstenite = \"0.21\"\nfutures-util = \"0.3\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**コマンド追加**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex server  # RPCサーバー起動\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. GUI APIクライアントの完全書き換え\n\n**修正ファイル**: &#96;gui/src/lib/api/client.ts&#96;\n\n**変更点**:\n- **プロトコル**: HTTP/REST → WebSocket RPC\n- **接続先**: &#96;http://localhost:8787&#96; → &#96;ws://localhost:3001&#96;\n- **実装方式**: モックレスポンス → 実際のCLI通信\n\n**新アーキテクチャ**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nclass CodexAPIClient {\n  private protocolClient: WebSocket;",

        "contents": "# codex-responses-api-proxy\n\nA strict HTTP proxy that only forwards &#96;POST&#96; requests to &#96;/v1/responses&#96; to the OpenAI API (&#96;https://api.openai.com&#96;), injecting the &#96;Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY&#96; header. Everything else is rejected with &#96;403 Forbidden&#96;.\n\n## Expected Usage\n\n**IMPORTANT:** &#96;codex-responses-api-proxy&#96; is designed to be run by a privileged user with access to &#96;OPENAI_API_KEY&#96; so that an unprivileged user cannot inspect or tamper with the process. Though if &#96;--http-shutdown&#96; is specified, an unprivileged user _can_ make a &#96;GET&#96; request to &#96;/shutdown&#96; to shutdown the server, as an unprivileged user could not send &#96;SIGTERM&#96; to kill the process.\n\nA privileged user (i.e., &#96;root&#96; or a user with &#96;sudo&#96;) who has access to &#96;OPENAI_API_KEY&#96; would run the following to start the server, as &#96;codex-responses-api-proxy&#96; reads the auth token from &#96;stdin&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;shell\nprintenv OPENAI_API_KEY | env -u OPENAI_API_KEY codex-responses-api-proxy --http-shutdown --server-info /tmp/server-info.json\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nA non-privileged user would then run Codex as follows, specifying the &#96;model_provider&#96; dynamically:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;shell\nPROXY_PORT=$(jq .port /tmp/server-info.json)\nPROXY_BASE_URL=\"http://127.0.0.1:${PROXY_PORT}\"\ncodex exec -c \"model_providers.openai-proxy={ name = 'OpenAI Proxy', base_url = '${PROXY_BASE_URL}/v1', wire_api='responses' }\" \\\n    -c model_provider=\"openai-proxy\" \\\n    'Your prompt here'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nWhen the unprivileged user was finished, they could shutdown the server using &#96;curl&#96; (since &#96;kill -SIGTERM&#96; is not an option):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;shell\ncurl --fail --silent --show-error \"${PROXY_BASE_URL}/shutdown\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Reads the API key from &#96;stdin&#96;. All callers should pipe the key in (for example, &#96;printenv OPENAI_API_KEY | codex-responses-api-proxy&#96;).\n- Formats the header value as &#96;Bearer &lt;key&gt;&#96; and attempts to &#96;mlock(2)&#96; the memory holding that header so it is not swapped to disk.\n- Listens on the provided port or an ephemeral port if &#96;--port&#96; is not specified.\n- Accepts exactly &#96;POST /v1/responses&#96; (no query string). The request body is forwarded to &#96;https://api.openai.com/v1/responses&#96; with &#96;Authorization: Bearer &lt;key&gt;&#96; set. All original request headers (except any incoming &#96;Authorization&#96;) are forwarded upstream, with &#96;Host&#96; overridden to &#96;api.openai.com&#96;. For other requests, it responds with &#96;403&#96;.",
        "signatures": {},

            "text": "## Expected Usage",

            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "**IMPORTANT:** &#96;codex-responses-api-proxy&#96; is designed to be run by a privileged user with access to &#96;OPENAI_API_KEY&#96; so that an unprivileged user cannot inspect or tamper with the process. Though if &#96;--http-shutdown&#96; is specified, an unprivileged user _can_ make a &#96;GET&#96; request to &#96;/shutdown&#96; to shutdown the server, as an unprivileged user could not send &#96;SIGTERM&#96; to kill the process.",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "A privileged user (i.e., &#96;root&#96; or a user with &#96;sudo&#96;) who has access to &#96;OPENAI_API_KEY&#96; would run the following to start the server, as &#96;codex-responses-api-proxy&#96; reads the auth token from &#96;stdin&#96;:",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;shell",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "printenv OPENAI_API_KEY | env -u OPENAI_API_KEY codex-responses-api-proxy --http-shutdown --server-info /tmp/server-info.json",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "A non-privileged user would then run Codex as follows, specifying the &#96;model_provider&#96; dynamically:",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;shell",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "PROXY_PORT=$(jq .port /tmp/server-info.json)",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "PROXY_BASE_URL=\"http://127.0.0.1:${PROXY_PORT}\"",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "codex exec -c \"model_providers.openai-proxy={ name = 'OpenAI Proxy', base_url = '${PROXY_BASE_URL}/v1', wire_api='responses' }\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    -c model_provider=\"openai-proxy\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    'Your prompt here'",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "When the unprivileged user was finished, they could shutdown the server using &#96;curl&#96; (since &#96;kill -SIGTERM&#96; is not an option):",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;shell",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "curl --fail --silent --show-error \"${PROXY_BASE_URL}/shutdown\"",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "## Behavior",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- Reads the API key from &#96;stdin&#96;. All callers should pipe the key in (for example, &#96;printenv OPENAI_API_KEY | codex-responses-api-proxy&#96;).",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- Formats the header value as &#96;Bearer &lt;key&gt;&#96; and attempts to &#96;mlock(2)&#96; the memory holding that header so it is not swapped to disk.",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- Listens on the provided port or an ephemeral port if &#96;--port&#96; is not specified.",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- Accepts exactly &#96;POST /v1/responses&#96; (no query string). The request body is forwarded to &#96;https://api.openai.com/v1/responses&#96; with &#96;Authorization: Bearer &lt;key&gt;&#96; set. All original request headers (except any incoming &#96;Authorization&#96;) are forwarded upstream, with &#96;Host&#96; overridden to &#96;api.openai.com&#96;. For other requests, it responds with &#96;403&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 36
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.36680424213409424
    },
