        "contents": "# codex-app-server\n\n&#96;codex app-server&#96; is the interface Codex uses to power rich interfaces such as the [Codex VS Code extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=openai.chatgpt).\n\n## Table of Contents\n\n- [Protocol](#protocol)\n- [Message Schema](#message-schema)\n- [Core Primitives](#core-primitives)\n- [Lifecycle Overview](#lifecycle-overview)\n- [Initialization](#initialization)\n- [API Overview](#api-overview)\n- [Events](#events)\n- [Auth endpoints](#auth-endpoints)\n\n## Protocol\n\nSimilar to [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/), &#96;codex app-server&#96; supports bidirectional communication, streaming JSONL over stdio. The protocol is JSON-RPC 2.0, though the &#96;\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\"&#96; header is omitted.\n\n## Message Schema\n\nCurrently, you can dump a TypeScript version of the schema using &#96;codex app-server generate-ts&#96;, or a JSON Schema bundle via &#96;codex app-server generate-json-schema&#96;. Each output is specific to the version of Codex you used to run the command, so the generated artifacts are guaranteed to match that version.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ncodex app-server generate-ts --out DIR\ncodex app-server generate-json-schema --out DIR\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Primitives\n\nThe API exposes three top level primitives representing an interaction between a user and Codex:\n\n- **Thread**: A conversation between a user and the Codex agent. Each thread contains multiple turns.\n- **Turn**: One turn of the conversation, typically starting with a user message and finishing with an agent message. Each turn contains multiple items.\n- **Item**: Represents user inputs and agent outputs as part of the turn, persisted and used as the context for future conversations. Example items include user message, agent reasoning, agent message, shell command, file edit, etc.\n\nUse the thread APIs to create, list, or archive conversations. Drive a conversation with turn APIs and stream progress via turn notifications.\n\n## Lifecycle Overview\n\n- Initialize once: Immediately after launching the codex app-server process, send an &#96;initialize&#96; request with your client metadata, then emit an &#96;initialized&#96; notification. Any other request before this handshake gets rejected.\n- Start (or resume) a thread: Call &#96;thread/start&#96; to open a fresh conversation. The response returns the thread object and you’ll also get a &#96;thread/started&#96; notification. If you’re continuing an existing conversation, call &#96;thread/resume&#96; with its ID instead.",

format!(\"{host}:{port}\"),\n        (Some(host), None) =&gt; host.to_string(),\n        _ =&gt; return Err(anyhow!(\"upstream URL must include a host\")),\n    };\n    let host_header =\n        HeaderValue::from_str(&amp;host).context(\"constructing Host header from upstream URL\")?;\n\n    let forward_config = Arc::new(ForwardConfig {\n        upstream_url,\n        host_header,\n    });\n\n    let (listener, bound_addr) = bind_listener(args.port)?;\n    if let Some(path) = args.server_info.as_ref() {\n        write_server_info(path, bound_addr.port())?;\n    }\n    let server = Server::from_listener(listener, None)\n        .map_err(|err| anyhow!(\"creating HTTP server: {err}\"))?;\n    let client = Arc::new(\n        Client::builder()\n            // Disable reqwest's 30s default so long-lived response streams keep flowing.\n            .timeout(None::&lt;Duration&gt;)\n            .build()\n            .context(\"building reqwest client\")?,\n    );\n\n    eprintln!(\"responses-api-proxy listening on {bound_addr}\");\n\n    let http_shutdown = args.http_shutdown;\n    for request in server.incoming_requests() {\n        let client = client.clone();\n        let forward_config = forward_config.clone();\n        std::thread::spawn(move || {\n            if http_shutdown &amp;&amp;         "contents": "use axum::{\n    routing::{get, post, delete},\n    Router,\n};\nuse std::net::SocketAddr;\nuse tower_http::cors::{Any, CorsLayer};\nuse tower_http::trace::TraceLayer;\nuse tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n\nmod api;\nmod git;\nmod types;\nmod websocket;\n\n#[tokio::main]\nasync fn main() -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n    // Initialize tracing\n    tracing_subscriber::registry()\n        .with(\n            tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::try_from_default_env()\n                .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"codex_viz_backend=debug,tower_http=debug\".into()),\n        )\n        .with(tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer())\n        .init();\n\n    tracing::info!(\"🚀 Codex Viz Backend starting...\");\n\n    // Create collaboration state\n    let collab_state = api::collaboration::CollaborationState::new();\n\n    // Build our application with routes\n    let app = Router::new()\n        // API routes\n        .route",

View at: ${shareUrl}&#96;\n    }\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: error.message\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// Tool: Analyze Code Quality\nasync function analyzeCode(code: string, language: string) {\n  // Simple static analysis\n  const lines = code.split('\\n')\n}",

bool {\n        self.policy_enforcer\n            .requires_approval(PrivilegedOperation::Network)\n    }\n\n    /// Create approval dialog for a research request\n    pub fn create_approval_dialog(&amp;self, request: &amp;ResearchRequest) -&gt; ResearchApprovalDialog {\n        ResearchApprovalDialog::from_request(request)\n    }\n\n    /// Execute research (after approval if required)\n    pub async fn execute_research(\n        &amp;self,\n        request: &amp;ResearchRequest,\n        approved: bool,\n    ) -&gt;         "contents": "        let researcher = DeepResearcher::new(config.clone(), provider);\n\n        // Conduct research\n        let report = researcher\n            .research(&amp;request.query)\n            .await\n            .context(\"Research failed\")?;\n\n        // Filter sources by cross-source agreement (≥2 credible sources)\n        let filtered_sources = self.filter_by_agreement(&amp;report.sources);\n\n        // Calculate overall confidence from findings\n        let overall_confidence = if report.findings.is_empty() {\n            0.5\n        } else {\n            report.findings.iter().map(|f| f.confidence).sum::&lt;f64&gt;() / report.findings.len() as f64\n        };\n\n        // Convert to ResearchBlock\n        let research_block = ResearchBlock {\n            query: request.query.clone(),\n            depth: request.depth,\n            strategy: format!(\"{:?}\", request.strategy).to_lowercase(),\n            sources: filtered_sources\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| ResearchSource {\n                    title: s.title.clone(),\n                    url: s.url.clone(),\n                    date: \"Unknown\".to_string(), // Source doesn't have date field\n                    key_finding: s.snippet.chars().take(200).collect(),\n                    confidence: s.relevance_score,\n                })\n                .collect(),\n            synthesis: report.summary,\n            confidence: overall_confidence,\n            needs_approval: self.requires_approval(),\n            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now(),\n        };\n\n        Ok(research_block)\n    }\n\n    /// Filter sources by cross-source agreement\n    fn filter_by_agreement(\n        &amp;self,\n        sources: &amp;[codex_deep_research::types::Source],\n    ) -&gt; Vec&lt;codex_deep_research::types::Source&gt; {\n        // For now, require relevance_score ≥ 0.7\n        // TODO: Implement actual cross-source agreement checking\n        sources\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.relevance_score &gt;= 0.7)\n            .cloned()\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]",

        "contents": "//! Secret masking utilities for preventing sensitive information leakage\n//!\n//! Provides functions to mask API keys, tokens, passwords, and other sensitive\n//! data in logs, error messages, and debug output.\n\nuse once_cell::sync::Lazy;\nuse std::sync::Mutex;\n\n// Compile regex patterns once at startup\n// If compilation fails, we'll use a fallback that returns the original text\nstatic OPENAI_API_KEY_PROJ_REGEX: Lazy&lt;Result&lt;regex::Regex, regex::Error&gt;&gt; =\n    Lazy::new(|| regex::Regex::new(r\"sk-proj-[A-Za-z0-9]{32,}\"));\nstatic OPENAI_API_KEY_REGEX: Lazy&lt;Result&lt;regex::Regex, regex::Error&gt;&gt; =\n    Lazy::new(|| regex::Regex::new(r\"sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{32,}\"));\nstatic GITHUB_TOKEN_REGEX: Lazy&lt;Result&lt;regex::Regex, regex::Error&gt;&gt; =\n    Lazy::new(|| regex::Regex::new(r\"(ghp|gho|ghu|ghs|ghr)_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}\"));\nstatic GOOGLE_API_KEY_REGEX: Lazy&lt;Result&lt;regex::Regex, regex::Error&gt;&gt; =\n    Lazy::new(|| regex::Regex::new(r\"AIzaSy[A-Za-z0-9_-]{35}\"));\nstatic BEARER_TOKEN_REGEX: Lazy&lt;Result&lt;regex::Regex, regex::Error&gt;&gt; =\n    Lazy::new(|| regex::Regex::new(r\"Bearer\\s+[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\"));\nstatic PASSWORD_REGEX: Lazy&lt;Result&lt;regex::Regex, regex::Error&gt;&gt; = Lazy::new(|| {\n    regex::Regex::new(r\"(?i)(password|pwd|pass|secret|token|api[_-]?key)\\s*[:=]\\s*([^\\s&amp;]+)\")\n});\nstatic URL_CREDENTIALS_REGEX: Lazy&lt;Result&lt;regex::Regex, regex::Error&gt;&gt; =\n    Lazy::new(|| regex::Regex::new(r\"https?://[^:]+:[^@]+@\"));\n\n// Track if regex compilation failed (for logging/debugging)\nstatic REGEX_COMPILATION_ERROR: Lazy&lt;Mutex&lt;Option&lt;String&gt;&gt;&gt; = Lazy::new(|| Mutex::new(None));\n\n/// Mask sensitive strings in text (API keys, tokens, passwords)\npub fn mask_secrets(text: &amp;str) -&gt; String {\n    // Patterns to detect and mask:\n    //",

        "contents": "impl ResearchApprovalDialog {\n    /// Create approval dialog for a research request\n    pub fn from_request(request: &amp;ResearchRequest) -&gt; Self {\n        // Estimate domains based on strategy\n        let domains = match request.strategy {\n            ResearchStrategy::Focused =&gt; {\n                vec![\"duckduckgo.com\".to_string(), \"github.com\".to_string()]\n            }\n            ResearchStrategy::Comprehensive =&gt; vec![\n                \"duckduckgo.com\".to_string(),\n                \"github.com\".to_string(),\n                \"stackoverflow.com\".to_string(),\n                \"docs.rs\".to_string(),\n            ],\n            ResearchStrategy::Exploratory =&gt; vec![\n                \"duckduckgo.com\".to_string(),\n                \"github.com\".to_string(),\n                \"reddit.com\".to_string(),\n                \"medium.com\".to_string(),\n                \"dev.to\".to_string(),\n            ],\n        };\n\n        // Estimate budgets\n        let token_budget = match request.depth {\n            1 =&gt; 10_000,\n            2 =&gt; 25_000,\n            _ =&gt; 50_000,\n        };\n\n        let time_budget_secs = match request.strategy {\n            ResearchStrategy::Focused =&gt; 60,\n            ResearchStrategy::Comprehensive =&gt; 180,\n            ResearchStrategy::Exploratory =&gt; 300,\n        };\n\n        Self {\n            query: request.query.clone(),\n            depth: request.depth,\n            domains,\n            token_budget,\n            time_budget_secs,\n            data_retention: \"Research results stored locally for 30 days, then auto-deleted\"\n                .to_string(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Research integration manager\npub struct ResearchIntegration {\n    policy_enforcer: Arc&lt;PolicyEnforcer&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl ResearchIntegration {\n    /// Create a new research integration",

URLs with credentials: https://user:pass@host\n\n    let mut masked = text.to_string();\n\n    // Mask OpenAI API keys (sk-proj-... or sk-...)\n    if let Ok(re) = OPENAI_API_KEY_PROJ_REGEX.as_ref() {\n        masked = re.replace_all(&amp;masked, \"sk-proj-***MASKED***\").to_string();\n    } else {\n        log_regex_error(\"OPENAI_API_KEY_PROJ_REGEX\");\n    }\n    if let Ok(re) = OPENAI_API_KEY_REGEX.as_ref() {\n        masked = re.replace_all(&amp;masked, \"sk-***MASKED***\").to_string();\n    } else {\n        log_regex_error(\"OPENAI_API_KEY_REGEX\");\n    }\n\n    // Mask GitHub tokens (ghp_..., gho_..., ghu_..., ghs_..., ghr_...)\n    if let Ok(re) = GITHUB_TOKEN_REGEX.as_ref() {\n        masked = re.replace_all(&amp;masked, \"$1_***MASKED***\").to_string();\n    } else {\n        log_regex_error(\"GITHUB_TOKEN_REGEX\");\n    }\n\n    // Mask Google API keys (AIzaSy...)\n    if let Ok(re) = GOOGLE_API_KEY_REGEX.as_ref() {\n        masked = re.replace_all(&amp;masked, \"AIzaSy***MASKED***\").to_string();\n    } else {\n        log_regex_error(\"GOOGLE_API_KEY_REGEX\");\n    }\n\n    // Mask Bearer tokens\n    if let Ok(re) = BEARER_TOKEN_REGEX.as_ref() {\n        masked = re.replace_all(&amp;masked, \"Bearer ***MASKED***\").to_string();\n    } else {\n        log_regex_error(\"BEARER_TOKEN_REGEX\");\n    }\n\n    // Mask passwords in query strings or form data\n    if let Ok(re) = PASSWORD_REGEX.as_ref() {\n        masked = re.replace_all(&amp;masked, \"$1=***MASKED***\").to_string();\n    } else {\n        log_regex_error(\"PASSWORD_REGEX\");\n    }\n\n    // Mask URLs with credentials (https://user:pass@host)\n    if let Ok(re) = URL_CREDENTIALS_REGEX.as_ref() {\n        masked = re.replace_all(&amp;masked, \"https://***MASKED***@\").to_string();\n    } else {\n        log_regex_error(\"URL_CREDENTIALS_REGEX\");\n    }\n\n    masked\n}\n\n/// Log regex compilation error (only once)",

        "contents": "            .cloned()\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::plan::policy::PlanPolicy;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_approval_dialog_creation() {\n        let request = ResearchRequest {\n            query: \"Rust async patterns\".to_string(),\n            depth: 2,\n            strategy: ResearchStrategy::Focused,\n            requester: Some(\"user1\".to_string()),\n            requester_role: Some(ApprovalRole::Maintainer),\n        };\n\n        let dialog = ResearchApprovalDialog::from_request(&amp;request);\n\n        assert_eq!(dialog.query, \"Rust async patterns\");\n        assert_eq!(dialog.depth, 2);\n        assert!(!dialog.domains.is_empty());\n        assert!(dialog.token_budget &gt; 0);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_budget_estimates() {\n        let request1 = ResearchRequest {\n            query: \"test\".to_string(),\n            depth: 1,\n            strategy: ResearchStrategy::Focused,\n            requester: None,\n            requester_role: None,\n        };\n\n        let dialog1 = ResearchApprovalDialog::from_request(&amp;request1);\n        assert_eq!(dialog1.token_budget, 10_000);\n\n        let request3 = ResearchRequest {\n            query: \"test\".to_string(),\n            depth: 3,\n            strategy: ResearchStrategy::Comprehensive,\n            requester: None,\n            requester_role: None,\n        };\n\n        let dialog3 = ResearchApprovalDialog::from_request(&amp;request3);\n        assert_eq!(dialog3.token_budget, 50_000);\n        assert!(dialog3.time_budget_secs &gt; dialog1.time_budget_secs);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_requires_approval() {\n        let policy = PlanPolicy::default();\n        let enforcer = Arc::new(PolicyEnforcer::new(policy));\n        let integration = ResearchIntegration::new(enforcer);\n\n        assert!(integration.requires_approval());\n    }\n}",

Please try signing in again.\",\n    \"type\": \"invalid_request_error\",\n    \"param\": null,\n    \"code\": \"refresh_token_reused\"\n  }\n}\"#;\n        let message = try_parse_error_message(text);\n        assert_eq!(\n            message,\n            \"Your refresh token has already been used to generate a new access token.         "contents": "impl ResearchApprovalDialog {\n    /// Create approval dialog for a research request\n    pub fn from_request(request: &amp;ResearchRequest) -&gt; Self {\n        // Estimate domains based on strategy\n        let domains = match request.strategy {\n            ResearchStrategy::Focused =&gt; {\n                vec![\"duckduckgo.com\".to_string(), \"github.com\".to_string()]\n            }\n            ResearchStrategy::Comprehensive =&gt; vec![\n                \"duckduckgo.com\".to_string(),\n                \"github.com\".to_string(),\n                \"stackoverflow.com\".to_string(),\n                \"docs.rs\".to_string(),\n            ],\n            ResearchStrategy::Exploratory =&gt; vec![\n                \"duckduckgo.com\".to_string(),\n                \"github.com\".to_string(),\n                \"reddit.com\".to_string(),\n                \"medium.com\".to_string(),\n                \"dev.to\".to_string(),\n            ],\n        };\n\n        // Estimate budgets\n        let token_budget = match request.depth {\n            1 =&gt; 10_000,\n            2 =&gt; 25_000,\n            _ =&gt; 50_000,\n        };\n\n        let time_budget_secs = match request.strategy {\n            ResearchStrategy::Focused =&gt; 60,\n            ResearchStrategy::Comprehensive =&gt; 180,\n            ResearchStrategy::Exploratory =&gt; 300,\n        };\n\n        Self {\n            query: request.query.clone(),\n            depth: request.depth,\n            domains,\n            token_budget,\n            time_budget_secs,\n            data_retention: \"Research results stored locally for 30 days, then auto-deleted\"\n                .to_string(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Research integration manager\npub struct ResearchIntegration {\n    policy_enforcer: Arc&lt;PolicyEnforcer&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl ResearchIntegration {\n    /// Create a new research integration",

bool {\n        self.policy_enforcer\n            .requires_approval(PrivilegedOperation::Network)\n    }\n\n    /// Create approval dialog for a research request\n    pub fn create_approval_dialog(&amp;self, request: &amp;ResearchRequest) -&gt; ResearchApprovalDialog {\n        ResearchApprovalDialog::from_request(request)\n    }\n\n    /// Execute research (after approval if required)\n    pub async fn execute_research(\n        &amp;self,\n        request: &amp;ResearchRequest,\n        approved: bool,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;ResearchBlock&gt; {\n        // Check policy\n        if self.requires_approval() {\n            if !approved {\n                anyhow::bail!(\"Research requires approval but was not approved\");\n            }\n\n            // Verify role if provided\n            if let (Some(role), Some(_requester)) = (request.requester_role, &amp;request.requester) {\n                self.policy_enforcer\n                    .enforce(PrivilegedOperation::Network, Some(role), None)?;\n            } else {\n                anyhow::bail!(\"Research approval requires user role information\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        info!(\"Executing research: {}\", request.query);\n        debug!(\"Depth: {}, Strategy: {:?}\", request.depth, request.strategy);\n\n        // Configure researcher\n        let config = DeepResearcherConfig {\n            max_depth: request.depth,\n            max_sources: match request.strategy {\n                ResearchStrategy::Focused =&gt; 5,\n                ResearchStrategy::Comprehensive =&gt; 10,\n                ResearchStrategy::Exploratory =&gt; 15,\n            },\n            strategy: request.strategy,\n        };\n\n        // Create provider (use web search provider as default)\n        let provider = Arc::new(codex_web_search::WebSearchProvider::new(3, 30));\n\n        let researcher = DeepResearcher::new(config.clone(), provider);",

URLs with credentials: https://user:pass@host\n\n    let mut masked = text.to_string();\n\n    // Mask OpenAI API keys (sk-proj-... or sk-...)\n    if let Ok(re) = OPENAI_API_KEY_PROJ_REGEX.as_ref() {\n        masked = re.replace_all(&amp;masked, \"sk-proj-***MASKED***\").to_string();\n    } else {\n        log_regex_error(\"OPENAI_API_KEY_PROJ_REGEX\");\n    }\n    if let Ok(re) = OPENAI_API_KEY_REGEX.as_ref() {\n        masked = re.replace_all(&amp;masked, \"sk-***MASKED***\").to_string();\n    } else {\n        log_regex_error(\"OPENAI_API_KEY_REGEX\");\n    }\n\n    // Mask GitHub tokens (ghp_..., gho_..., ghu_..., ghs_..., ghr_...)\n    if let Ok(re) = GITHUB_TOKEN_REGEX.as_ref() {\n        masked = re.replace_all(&amp;masked, \"$1_***MASKED***\").to_string();\n    } else {\n        log_regex_error(\"GITHUB_TOKEN_REGEX\");\n    }\n\n    // Mask Google API keys (AIzaSy...)\n    if let Ok(re) = GOOGLE_API_KEY_REGEX.as_ref() {\n        masked = re.replace_all(&amp;masked, \"AIzaSy***MASKED***\").to_string();\n    } else {\n        log_regex_error(\"GOOGLE_API_KEY_REGEX\");\n    }\n\n    // Mask Bearer tokens\n    if let Ok(re) = BEARER_TOKEN_REGEX.as_ref() {\n        masked = re.replace_all(&amp;masked, \"Bearer ***MASKED***\").to_string();\n    } else {\n        log_regex_error(\"BEARER_TOKEN_REGEX\");\n    }\n\n    // Mask passwords in query strings or form data\n    if let Ok(re) = PASSWORD_REGEX.as_ref() {\n        masked = re.replace_all(&amp;masked, \"$1=***MASKED***\").to_string();\n    } else {\n        log_regex_error(\"PASSWORD_REGEX\");\n    }\n\n    // Mask URLs with credentials (https://user:pass@host)\n    if let Ok(re) = URL_CREDENTIALS_REGEX.as_ref() {\n        masked = re.replace_all(&amp;masked, \"https://***MASKED***@\").to_string();\n    } else {\n        log_regex_error(\"URL_CREDENTIALS_REGEX\");\n    }\n\n    masked\n}\n\n/// Log regex compilation error (only once)",

        "contents": "            .cloned()\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::plan::policy::PlanPolicy;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_approval_dialog_creation() {\n        let request = ResearchRequest {\n            query: \"Rust async patterns\".to_string(),\n            depth: 2,\n            strategy: ResearchStrategy::Focused,\n            requester: Some(\"user1\".to_string()),\n            requester_role: Some(ApprovalRole::Maintainer),\n        };\n\n        let dialog = ResearchApprovalDialog::from_request(&amp;request);\n\n        assert_eq!(dialog.query, \"Rust async patterns\");\n        assert_eq!(dialog.depth, 2);\n        assert!(!dialog.domains.is_empty());\n        assert!(dialog.token_budget &gt; 0);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_budget_estimates() {\n        let request1 = ResearchRequest {\n            query: \"test\".to_string(),\n            depth: 1,\n            strategy: ResearchStrategy::Focused,\n            requester: None,\n            requester_role: None,\n        };\n\n        let dialog1 = ResearchApprovalDialog::from_request(&amp;request1);\n        assert_eq!(dialog1.token_budget, 10_000);\n\n        let request3 = ResearchRequest {\n            query: \"test\".to_string(),\n            depth: 3,\n            strategy: ResearchStrategy::Comprehensive,\n            requester: None,\n            requester_role: None,\n        };\n\n        let dialog3 = ResearchApprovalDialog::from_request(&amp;request3);\n        assert_eq!(dialog3.token_budget, 50_000);\n        assert!(dialog3.time_budget_secs &gt; dialog1.time_budget_secs);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_requires_approval() {\n        let policy = PlanPolicy::default();\n        let enforcer = Arc::new(PolicyEnforcer::new(policy));\n        let integration = ResearchIntegration::new(enforcer);\n\n        assert!(integration.requires_approval());\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "}\n\n/// Log regex compilation error (only once)\nfn log_regex_error(regex_name: &amp;str) {\n    let mut error = REGEX_COMPILATION_ERROR.lock().unwrap();\n    if error.is_none() {\n        *error = Some(format!(\"Regex compilation failed for {}\", regex_name));\n        tracing::error!(\"Secret masking regex compilation failed: {}\", regex_name);\n    }\n}\n\n/// Mask secrets in error messages\npub fn mask_error_message(error: &amp;dyn std::error::Error) -&gt; String {\n    let error_string = format!(\"{}\", error);\n    mask_secrets(&amp;error_string)\n}\n\n/// Mask secrets in debug output\npub fn mask_debug_output&lt;T: std::fmt::Debug&gt;(value: &amp;T) -&gt; String {\n    let debug_string = format!(\"{:?}\", value);\n    mask_secrets(&amp;debug_string)\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_mask_openai_api_key() {\n        let text = \"API key: sk-proj-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456\";\n        let masked = mask_secrets(text);\n        assert!(masked.contains(\"sk-proj-***MASKED***\"));\n        assert!(!masked.contains(\"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456\"));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_mask_github_token() {\n        let text = \"Token: ghp_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456789\";\n        let masked = mask_secrets(text);\n        assert!(masked.contains(\"ghp_***MASKED***\"));\n        assert!(!masked.contains(\"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456789\"));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_mask_google_api_key() {\n        let text = \"Key: AIzaSyabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz12345\";\n        let masked = mask_secrets(text);\n        assert!(masked.contains(\"AIzaSy***MASKED***\"));\n        assert!(!masked.contains(\"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz12345\"));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_mask_bearer_token() {\n        let text = \"Authorization: Bearer abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456\";\n        let masked = mask_secrets(text);\n        assert!(masked.contains(\"Bearer ***MASKED***\"));\n        assert!(!masked.contains(\"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456\"));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_mask_url_credentials() {\n        let text = \"https://user:password@example.com/api\";",

## 実装完了

MCPツールの動的ロード機能とトークン節約機能の実装を完了しました。

### 実装した主要コンポーネント

1. **DynamicMcpLoader** - 実行時のMCPサーバー追加・削除・リロード
2. **McpFileWatcher** - 設定ファイルとプラグインディレクトリの監視
3. **McpPluginLoader** - プラグインの自動検出とロード
4. **McpApiServer** - REST APIエンドポイント（構造実装）
5. **McpTokenOptimizer** - ツール使用頻度追跡と自動アンロード
6. **SelectiveToolLoader** - タスクベースの選択的ツールロード
7. **McpPromptBuilder** - プロンプト構築時のツール選択と圧縮

### 作成ファイル

- 7つの新規Rustモジュール
- 3つのドキュメント（プラグイン開発ガイド、API仕様書、トークン最適化ガイド）
- 実装ログ

### 統合ポイント

- `Config`構造体に動的ロード設定を追加
- `SessionServices`に`DynamicMcpLoader`を統合
- `McpConnectionManager`に動的ロードメソッドを追加
- CLIコマンドを拡張

### トークン節約機能

- 使用頻度ベースの自動アンロード
- タスクベースの選択的ロード
- ツール説明の圧縮（50-70%削減）
- プロンプトへの選択的追加

すべてのTODOを完了しました。実装ログは`_docs/2025-12-30_MCPツール動的ロード機能実装{main}.md`に保存されています。

        "contents": "    compress_descriptions: bool,\n}\n\nimpl McpTokenOptimizer {\n    /// Create a new token optimizer\n    pub fn new(\n        auto_unload_threshold: Duration,\n        min_usage_count: u64,\n        compress_descriptions: bool,\n        token_tracker: Option&lt;Arc&lt;TokenBudgetTracker&gt;&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            tool_usage_stats: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),\n            token_tracker,\n            auto_unload_threshold,\n            min_usage_count,\n            compress_descriptions,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Track tool usage\n    pub async fn track_tool_usage(&amp;self, tool_name: &amp;str, server_name: &amp;str, tokens: u64) {\n        let mut stats = self.tool_usage_stats.lock().await;\n        let key = format!(\"{}__{}\", server_name, tool_name);\n        \n        let stat = stats.entry(key.clone()).or_insert_with(|| ToolUsageStats {\n            tool_name: tool_name.to_string(),\n            server_name: server_name.to_string(),\n            usage_count: 0,\n            last_used: SystemTime::now(),\n            total_tokens_consumed: 0,\n            average_tokens_per_call: 0.0,\n        });\n\n        stat.usage_count += 1;\n        stat.last_used = SystemTime::now();\n        stat.total_tokens_consumed += tokens;\n        stat.average_tokens_per_call = stat.total_tokens_consumed as f64 / stat.usage_count as f64;\n\n        debug!(\n            \"Tracked tool usage: {} (count: {}, tokens: {})\",\n            tool_name, stat.usage_count, tokens\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// Get unused tools that exceed the threshold\n    pub async fn get_unused_tools(&amp;self, threshold: Duration) -&gt; Vec&lt;String&gt; {\n        let stats = self.tool_usage_stats.lock().await;\n        let now = SystemTime::now();\n        let mut unused = Vec::new();",

        "contents": "//! Root of the &#96;codex-core&#96; library.\n\n// Prevent accidental direct writes to stdout/stderr in library code. All\n// user-visible output must go through the appropriate abstraction (e.g.,\n// the TUI or the tracing stack).\n#![deny(clippy::print_stdout, clippy::print_stderr)]\n\npub mod         "contents": "pub struct McpTokenOptimizationConfig {\n    /// Enable token optimization\n    #[serde(default = \"default_true\")]\n    pub enabled: bool,\n\n    /// Enable automatic unloading of unused tools\n    #[serde(default = \"default_true\")]\n    pub auto_unload_enabled: bool,\n\n    /// Time threshold for auto-unloading (in seconds)\n    #[serde(default = \"default_auto_unload_threshold_secs\")]\n    pub auto_unload_threshold_secs: u64,\n\n    /// Minimum usage count before considering for unload\n    #[serde(default = \"default_min_usage_count\")]\n    pub min_usage_count: u64,\n\n    /// Compress tool descriptions\n    #[serde(default = \"default_true\")]\n    pub compress_descriptions: bool,\n\n    /// Maximum tools per prompt\n    #[serde(default = \"default_max_tools_per_prompt\")]\n    pub max_tools_per_prompt: usize,\n\n    /// Token budget per prompt (None = unlimited)\n    pub token_budget_per_prompt: Option&lt;u64&gt;,\n}\n\nfn default_auto_unload_threshold_secs() -&gt; u64 {\n    3600 // 1 hour\n}\n\nfn default_min_usage_count() -&gt; u64 {\n    0\n}\n\nfn default_max_tools_per_prompt() -&gt; usize {\n    50\n}\n\nimpl Default for McpTokenOptimizationConfig {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            enabled: true,\n            auto_unload_enabled: true,\n            auto_unload_threshold_secs: 3600,\n            min_usage_count: 0,\n            compress_descriptions: true,\n            max_tools_per_prompt: 50,\n            token_budget_per_prompt: None,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn default_true() -&gt; bool {\n    true\n}\n\n#[derive(Serialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]\npub struct McpServerConfig {\n    #[serde(flatten)]",

        "contents": "    /// Build prompt with selected tools\n    pub fn build_prompt_with_tools(\n        &amp;self,\n        base_prompt: &amp;str,\n        available_tools: &amp;[Tool],\n        task_context: &amp;str,\n    ) -&gt; All relative paths provided by\n    /// the model as well as sandbox policies are resolved against this path\n    /// instead of &#96;std::env::current_dir()&#96;.\n    pub(crate) cwd: PathBuf,\n    pub(crate) developer_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) base_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) compact_prompt: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) user_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) approval_policy: AskForApproval,\n    pub(crate) sandbox_policy: SandboxPolicy,\n    pub(crate) shell_environment_policy: ShellEnvironmentPolicy,\n    pub(crate) tools_config: ToolsConfig,\n    pub(crate) ghost_snapshot: GhostSnapshotConfig,\n    pub(crate) final_output_json_schema: Option&lt;Value&gt;,\n    pub(crate) codex_linux_sandbox_exe: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n    pub(crate) tool_call_gate: Arc&lt;ReadinessFlag&gt;,\n    pub(crate) truncation_policy: TruncationPolicy,\n}\n\nimpl TurnContext {\n    pub(crate) fn resolve_path(&amp;self, path: Option&lt;String&gt;) -&gt; PathBuf {\n        path.as_ref()\n            .map(PathBuf::from)\n            .map_or_else(|| self.cwd.clone(), |p| self.cwd.join(p))\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) fn compact_prompt(&amp;self) -&gt; &amp;str {\n        self.compact_prompt\n            .as_deref()\n            .unwrap_or(compact::SUMMARIZATION_PROMPT)\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub(crate) struct SessionConfiguration {\n    /// Provider identifier (\"openai\", \"openrouter\", ...).",

        "contents": "/// Base config deserialized from ~/.codex/config.toml.\n#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq)]\npub struct ConfigToml {\n    /// Optional override of model selection.\n    pub model: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    /// Review model override used by the &#96;/review&#96; feature.\n    pub review_model: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Provider to use from the model_providers map.\n    pub model_provider: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Size of the context window for the model, in tokens.\n    pub model_context_window: Option&lt;i64&gt;,\n\n    /// Token usage threshold triggering auto-compaction of conversation history.\n    pub model_auto_compact_token_limit: Option&lt;i64&gt;,\n\n    /// Default approval policy for executing commands.\n    pub approval_policy: Option&lt;AskForApproval&gt;,\n\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub shell_environment_policy: ShellEnvironmentPolicyToml,\n\n    /// Sandbox mode to use.\n    pub sandbox_mode: Option&lt;SandboxMode&gt;,\n\n    /// Sandbox configuration to apply if &#96;sandbox&#96; is &#96;WorkspaceWrite&#96;.\n    pub sandbox_workspace_write: Option&lt;SandboxWorkspaceWrite&gt;,\n\n    /// Optional external command to spawn for end-user notifications.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub notify: Option&lt;Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt;,\n\n    /// System instructions.\n    pub instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Developer instructions inserted as a &#96;developer&#96;         "contents": "    pub max_bytes: Option&lt;usize&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Copy, Clone, PartialEq, Default)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"kebab-case\")]\npub enum HistoryPersistence {\n    /// Save all history entries to disk.\n    #[default]\n    SaveAll,\n    /// Do not write history to disk.\n    None,\n}\n\n// ===== OTEL configuration =====\n\n#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"kebab-case\")]\npub enum OtelHttpProtocol {\n    /// Binary payload\n    Binary,\n    /// JSON payload\n    Json,\n}\n\n#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Default)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"kebab-case\")]\npub struct OtelTlsConfig {\n    pub ca_certificate: Option&lt;AbsolutePathBuf&gt;,\n    pub client_certificate: Option&lt;AbsolutePathBuf&gt;,\n    pub client_private_key: Option&lt;AbsolutePathBuf&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Which OTEL exporter to use.\n#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"kebab-case\")]\npub enum OtelExporterKind {\n    None,\n    OtlpHttp {\n        endpoint: String,\n        #[serde(default)]\n        headers: HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;,\n        protocol: OtelHttpProtocol,\n        #[serde(default)]\n        tls: Option&lt;OtelTlsConfig&gt;,\n    },\n    OtlpGrpc {\n        endpoint: String,\n        #[serde(default)]\n        headers: HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;,\n        #[serde(default)]\n        tls: Option&lt;OtelTlsConfig&gt;,\n    },\n}\n\n/// OTEL settings loaded from config.toml. Fields are optional so we can apply defaults.\n#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Default)]\npub struct OtelConfigToml {\n    /// Log user prompt in traces\n    pub log_user_prompt: Option&lt;bool&gt;,\n\n    /// Mark traces with environment (dev, staging, prod, test). Defaults to dev.\n    pub environment: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Optional log exporter\n    pub exporter: Option&lt;OtelExporterKind&gt;,\n\n    /// Optional trace exporter\n    pub trace_exporter: Option&lt;OtelExporterKind&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Effective OTEL settings after defaults are applied.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]\npub struct OtelConfig {\n    pub log_user_prompt: bool,\n    pub environment: String,",

        "contents": "      - \"search-indexing\"\n\n  # Gemini CLI MCP - Gemini AI integration\n  gemini-cli:\n    command: \"codex-gemini-mcp\"\n    args: []\n    env:\n      GEMINI_API_KEY: \"${GEMINI_API_KEY}\"\n      GEMINI_MODEL: \"gemini-3.0-pro-latest\"\n      GEMINI_MAX_TOKENS: \"8192\"\n      GEMINI_TEMPERATURE: \"0.7\"\n      OAUTH_CLIENT_ID: \"${OAUTH_CLIENT_ID}\"\n      OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET: \"${OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET}\"\n    capabilities:\n      - \"ai-assistance\"\n      - \"code-generation\"\n      - \"code-review\"\n      - \"documentation\"\n      - \"research-assistance\"\n      - \"problem-solving\"\n      - \"creative-writing\"\n      - \"data-analysis\"\n\n# Development mode specific servers\ndevelopment:\n  parallel-dev:\n    - serena\n    - github\n    - git-enhanced\n    - filesystem\n    - playwright\n\n  centralized-dev:\n    - serena\n    - arxiv\n    - docs-analyzer\n    - youtube\n    - gemini-cli\n\n# Agent-specific server assignments\nagent_servers:\n  architect:\n    - serena\n    - docs-analyzer\n    - git-enhanced\n    - filesystem\n    - gemini-cli\n\n  researcher:\n    - arxiv\n    - github\n    - docs-analyzer\n    - youtube\n    - playwright\n\n  code-reviewer:\n    - serena\n    - github\n    - git-enhanced\n    - filesystem\n    - gemini-cli\n\n  qc-optimizer:\n    - serena\n    - github\n    - docs-analyzer\n    - filesystem\n    - playwright\n\n# Auto-start servers for different development modes\nauto_start:\n  centralized: [\"serena\", \"arxiv\"]\n  parallel: [\"serena\", \"github\", \"git-enhanced\"]",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\guides\\mcp-configuration.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 93

        },
        "contents": "# 🔧 Codex MCP Configuration Guide\n\n**Version**: codex-cli 0.47.0-alpha.1  \n**Last Updated**: 2025-10-12  \n**Configuration File**: &#96;~/.cursor/mcp.json&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 📋 Overview\n\nThis guide explains how to configure the Codex MCP (Model Context Protocol) server in Cursor IDE to leverage the production-ready meta-orchestration features.\n\n---\n\n## ⚙️ Configuration\n\n### Full &#96;mcp.json&#96; Entry\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"mcpServers\": {\n    \"codex\": {\n      \"command\": \"codex\",\n      \"args\": [\"mcp-server\"],\n      \"env\": {\n        \"RUST_LOG\": \"info\",\n        \"CODEX_CONFIG_PATH\": \"C:\\\\Users\\\\&lt;username&gt;\\\\.codex\\\\config.toml\"\n      },\n      \"description\": \"Codex MCP Server v0.47.0-alpha.1 - Production-Ready Meta-Orchestration System\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🛠️ Available Tools\n\n### 1. &#96;codex&#96;\n**Description**: Execute Codex with full capabilities\n\n**CLI Equivalent**: &#96;codex &lt;prompt&gt;&#96;\n\n**Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"tool\": \"codex\",\n  \"arguments\": {\n    \"prompt\": \"Implement user authentication with JWT\",\n    \"config\": {\n      \"model\": \"o3\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 2. &#96;codex-reply&#96;\n**Description**: Continue existing Codex conversation\n\n**Parameters**:\n- &#96;conversationId&#96; (string): Conversation ID to continue\n- &#96;prompt&#96; (string): Next user prompt\n\n**Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"tool\": \"codex-reply\",\n  \"arguments\": {\n    \"conversationId\": \"conv-abc123\",\n    \"prompt\": \"Now add password reset functionality\"\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 3. &#96;codex-supervisor&#96;\n**Description**: Coordinate multiple specialized AI agents\n\n**Parameters**:\n- &#96;goal&#96; (string): High-level goal to accomplish\n- &#96;agents&#96; (array, optional): Specific agent types to use\n- &#96;strategy&#96; (string, optional): Coordination strategy (&#96;sequential&#96;, &#96;parallel&#96;, &#96;hybrid&#96;)\n- &#96;merge_strategy&#96; (string, optional): Result merging (&#96;concatenate&#96;, &#96;voting&#96;, &#96;highest_score&#96;)\n\n**Available Agents**:\n- &#96;CodeExpert&#96; - Code implementation and refactoring\n- &#96;Researcher&#96; - Technology research and best practices\n- &#96;Tester&#96; - Test generation and coverage analysis\n- &#96;Security&#96; - Security audits and vulnerability scanning\n- &#96;Backend&#96; - Backend architecture and APIs",

        "contents": "# MCP設定ファイル同期管理ガイド\n\n**バージョン**: 0.48.0-zapabob.1  \n**作成日**: 2025-10-23  \n\n## 📋 概要\n\nCodexとCursor IDEは異なるMCP設定ファイルを使用します：\n\n| ツール | 設定ファイル | フォーマット |\n|--------|------------|------------|\n| **Codex CLI** | &#96;config.toml&#96; | TOML |\n| **Cursor IDE** | &#96;c:\\Users\\downl\\.cursor\\mcp.json&#96; | JSON |\n\n両ファイルを同期して管理する必要があります。\n\n## 🔧 設定ファイル構造\n\n### config.toml (Codex CLI用)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[mcp_servers.サーバー名]\ncommand = \"コマンド\"\nargs = [\"引数1\", \"引数2\"]\nenv.ENV_VAR = \"値\"\ndescription = \"説明\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### mcp.json (Cursor IDE用)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"mcpServers\": {\n    \"サーバー名\": {\n      \"type\": \"stdio\",\n      \"command\": \"コマンド\",\n      \"args\": [\"引数1\", \"引数2\"],\n      \"env\": {\n        \"ENV_VAR\": \"値\"\n      },\n      \"description\": \"説明\",\n      \"disabled\": false\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 📊 現在の設定状況\n\n### 共通MCPサーバー（両ファイルに存在）\n\n1. **codex** - Codexメインサーバー\n2. **serena** - AIオーケストレーション\n3. **context7** - Upstashコンテキスト管理\n4. **playwright** - Web自動化\n5. **filesystem** - ファイルシステム操作\n6. **github** - GitHub API操作\n7. **markitdown** - Markdown変換\n8. **arxiv-mcp-server** - arXiv論文検索\n9. **youtube** - YouTube動画操作\n10. **chrome-devtools** - Chrome DevTools\n11. **codex-gemini-mcp** - Gemini CLI MCP統合 ✨\n\n### Codex CLI専用（config.tomlのみ）\n\n12. **codex-supervisor** - マルチエージェント調整\n13. **codex-research** - ディープリサーチ\n14. **codex-agent** - 自然言語CLI\n\n## 🔄 新規MCPサーバー追加手順\n\n### 1. config.tomlに追加\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[mcp_servers.新サーバー名]\ncommand = \"コマンド\"\nargs = [\"引数\"]\nenv.変数名 = \"値\"\ndescription = \"説明\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. mcp.jsonに追加\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"mcpServers\": {\n    \"新サーバー名\": {\n      \"type\": \"stdio\",",

        "contents": "# Codex Minimal Configuration - 動作確認済みMCPサーバーのみ\n# 作成日: 2025-10-25\n# 目的: 高速起動・安定動作\n\n# ==================== モデル設定 ====================\nmodel = \"gpt-5-codex\"\n\n# 🆕 MCP Client機能を有効化\n# ⚠️ experimental_use_rmcp_client は現在問題があるため無効化\nexperimental_use_rmcp_client = false\n\n# 🔍 Web検索機能を有効化（モデル組み込み検索）\nenable_web_search = true\n\n# ==================== 機能フラグ ====================\n[features]\n# Web検索機能（モデル組み込み）\nweb_search = true\n# MCP統合\nmcp_integration = true\n\n# ==================== OpenAI Provider ====================\n[model_providers.openai]\nbase_url = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"\nenv_key = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\"\nname = \"OpenAI (Chat Completions API)\"\nrequires_openai_auth = true\nwire_api = \"chat\"\n# 🔍 Web検索機能を有効化\nenable_web_search = true\nweb_search_grounding = true\n\n# ==================== セキュリティ ====================\n[sandbox]\ndefault_mode = \"read-only\"\n\n[approval]\npolicy = \"on-request\"\n\n# ==================== MCP サーバー ====================\n# ✅ 動作確認済みサーバーのみ（2/15）\n\n# Codex MCP Server - メインサーバー（7ツール利用可能）\n[mcp_servers.codex]\nargs = [\"mcp-server\"]\ncommand = \"codex\"\nenv.GITHUB_TOKEN = \"${GITHUB_TOKEN}\"\nenv.OPENAI_API_KEY = \"${OPENAI_API_KEY}\"\nenv.RUST_LOG = \"info\"\nenv.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL = \"${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL}\"\nstartup_timeout_sec = 60\n\n# Gemini CLI - Google Gemini AI統合（OAuth 2.0、Google Search機能付き）\n# ⚠️ Note: Requires 'gemini' CLI to be installed\n[mcp_servers.codex-gemini-mcp]\nargs = []\ncommand = \"codex-gemini-mcp\"\ndescription = \"Codex Gemini CLI MCP Server v0.49.0 - Google Gemini AI integration with OAuth 2.0 authentication and Google Search Grounding\"\ndisabled = true\nenv.PATH = \"C:\\\\Users\\\\downl\\\\.cargo\\\\bin;${PATH}\"\nstartup_timeout_sec = 60\n\n# ==================== サブエージェント ====================\n[subagents]\nenabled = true\ninherit_model = true\nmax_parallel = 4",

GitHub API（TLS/mTLS）\n[mcp_servers.github]\ncommand = \"npx\"\nargs = [\"-y\", \"@modelcontextprotocol/server-github\"]\nenv.GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN = \"${GITHUB_TOKEN}\"\ntransport = \"https\"\nbind_address = \"127.0.0.1:8005\"\ntls_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/github-cert.pem\"\ntls_key = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/github-key.pem\"\nrequire_client_cert = true\nauth_method = \"mtls\"\n\n# Chrome DevTools -         "contents": "Currently, &#96;CODEX_SANDBOX_NETWORK_DISABLED=1&#96; is also added to the environment, assuming network is disabled. This is not configurable.\n\n## MCP integration\n\n### mcp_servers\n\nYou can configure Codex to use [MCP servers](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/about) to give Codex access to external applications, resources, or services.\n\n#### Server configuration\n\n##### STDIO\n\n[STDIO servers](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-06-18/basic/transports#stdio) are MCP servers that you can launch directly via commands on your computer.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n# The top-level table name must be &#96;mcp_servers&#96;\n# The sub-table name (&#96;server-name&#96; in this example) can be anything you would like.\n[mcp_servers.server_name]\ncommand = \"npx\"\n# Optional\nargs = [\"-y\", \"mcp-server\"]\n# Optional: propagate additional env vars to the MCP server.\n# A default whitelist of env vars will be propagated to the MCP server.\n# https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/codex-rs/rmcp-client/src/utils.rs#L82\nenv = { \"API_KEY\" = \"value\" }\n# or\n[mcp_servers.server_name.env]\nAPI_KEY = \"value\"\n# Optional: Additional list of environment variables that will be whitelisted in the MCP server's environment.\nenv_vars = [\"API_KEY2\"]\n\n# Optional: cwd that the command will be run from\ncwd = \"/Users/&lt;user&gt;/code/my-server\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n##### Streamable HTTP\n\n[Streamable HTTP servers](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-06-18/basic/transports#streamable-http) enable Codex to talk to resources that are accessed via a http url (either on localhost or another domain).\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[mcp_servers.figma]\nurl = \"https://mcp.figma.com/mcp\"\n# Optional environment variable containing a bearer token to use for auth\nbearer_token_env_var = \"ENV_VAR\"\n# Optional map of headers with hard-coded values.\nhttp_headers = { \"HEADER_NAME\" = \"HEADER_VALUE\" }\n# Optional map of headers whose values will be replaced with the environment variable.\nenv_http_headers = { \"HEADER_NAME\" = \"ENV_VAR\" }\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nStreamable HTTP connections always use the Rust MCP client under the hood. Run &#96;codex mcp login &lt;server-name&gt;&#96; to authenticate for servers supporting OAuth.\n\n#### Other configuration options\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
        "signatures": {},

            "text": "## MCP integration",
            "lineNumber": 418

            "lineNumber": 419

            "text": "### mcp_servers",
            "lineNumber": 420
          },

            "lineNumber": 421

          {

            "lineNumber": 422

          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 425
          },
          {
            "text": "##### STDIO",

          {
            "lineNumber": 427
          },
          {
            "text": "[STDIO servers](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-06-18/basic/transports#stdio) are MCP servers that you can launch directly via commands on your computer.",

            "text": "# The sub-table name (&#96;server-name&#96; in this example) can be anything you would like.",

          {
            "text": "env = { \"API_KEY\" = \"value\" }",
            "lineNumber": 440
          },
          {
            "text": "# or",
            "lineNumber": 441
          },
          {
            "text": "[mcp_servers.server_name.env]",
            "lineNumber": 442
          },
          {
            "text": "API_KEY = \"value\"",
            "lineNumber": 443
          },
          {
            "text": "# Optional: Additional list of environment variables that will be whitelisted in the MCP server's environment.",
            "lineNumber": 444
          },
          {
            "text": "env_vars = [\"API_KEY2\"]",
            "lineNumber": 445
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 446
          },
          {
            "text": "# Optional: cwd that the command will be run from",
            "lineNumber": 447
          },
          {
            "text": "cwd = \"/Users/&lt;user&gt;/code/my-server\"",
            "lineNumber": 448
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 449
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 450
          },
          {
            "text": "##### Streamable HTTP",
            "lineNumber": 451
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 452
          },
          {
            "text": "[Streamable HTTP servers](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-06-18/basic/transports#streamable-http) enable Codex to talk to resources that are accessed via a http url (either on localhost or another domain).",
            "lineNumber": 453
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 454
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 455
          },
          {
            "text": "[mcp_servers.figma]",
            "lineNumber": 456
          },
          {
            "text": "url = \"https://mcp.figma.com/mcp\"",
            "lineNumber": 457
          },
          {
            "text": "# Optional environment variable containing a bearer token to use for auth",
            "lineNumber": 458
          },
          {
            "text": "bearer_token_env_var = \"ENV_VAR\"",
            "lineNumber": 459
          },
          {
            "text": "# Optional map of headers with hard-coded values.",
            "lineNumber": 460
          },
          {
            "text": "http_headers = { \"HEADER_NAME\" = \"HEADER_VALUE\" }",
            "lineNumber": 461
          },
          {
            "text": "# Optional map of headers whose values will be replaced with the environment variable.",
            "lineNumber": 462
          },
          {
            "text": "env_http_headers = { \"HEADER_NAME\" = \"ENV_VAR\" }",
            "lineNumber": 463
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 464
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 465
          },
          {
            "text": "Streamable HTTP connections always use the Rust MCP client under the hood. Run &#96;codex mcp login &lt;server-name&gt;&#96; to authenticate for servers supporting OAuth.",
            "lineNumber": 466
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 467
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Other configuration options",
            "lineNumber": 468
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 469
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 470
          }
        ]

        "contents": "# MCP設定ファイル同期管理ガイド\n\n**バージョン**: 0.48.0-zapabob.1  \n**作成日**: 2025-10-23  \n\n## 📋 概要\n\nCodexとCursor IDEは異なるMCP設定ファイルを使用します：\n\n| ツール | 設定ファイル | フォーマット |\n|--------|------------|------------|\n| **Codex CLI** | &#96;config.toml&#96; | TOML |\n| **Cursor IDE** | &#96;c:\\Users\\downl\\.cursor\\mcp.json&#96; | JSON |\n\n両ファイルを同期して管理する必要があります。\n\n## 🔧 設定ファイル構造\n\n### config.toml (Codex CLI用)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[mcp_servers.サーバー名]\ncommand = \"コマンド\"\nargs = [\"引数1\", \"引数2\"]\nenv.ENV_VAR = \"値\"\ndescription = \"説明\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### mcp.json (Cursor IDE用)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"mcpServers\": {\n    \"サーバー名\": {\n      \"type\": \"stdio\",\n      \"command\": \"コマンド\",\n      \"args\": [\"引数1\", \"引数2\"],\n      \"env\": {\n        \"ENV_VAR\": \"値\"\n      },\n      \"description\": \"説明\",\n      \"disabled\": false\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 📊 現在の設定状況\n\n### 共通MCPサーバー（両ファイルに存在）\n\n1. **codex** - Codexメインサーバー\n2. **serena** - AIオーケストレーション\n3. **context7** - Upstashコンテキスト管理\n4. **playwright** - Web自動化\n5. **filesystem** - ファイルシステム操作\n6. **github** - GitHub API操作\n7. **markitdown** - Markdown変換\n8. **arxiv-mcp-server** - arXiv論文検索\n9. **youtube** - YouTube動画操作\n10. **chrome-devtools** - Chrome DevTools\n11. **codex-gemini-mcp** - Gemini CLI MCP統合 ✨\n\n### Codex CLI専用（config.tomlのみ）\n\n12. **codex-supervisor** - マルチエージェント調整\n13. **codex-research** - ディープリサーチ\n14. **codex-agent** - 自然言語CLI\n\n## 🔄 新規MCPサーバー追加手順\n\n### 1. config.tomlに追加\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[mcp_servers.新サーバー名]\ncommand = \"コマンド\"\nargs = [\"引数\"]\nenv.変数名 = \"値\"\ndescription = \"説明\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. mcp.jsonに追加\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"mcpServers\": {\n    \"新サーバー名\": {\n      \"type\": \"stdio\",",

        "contents": "# MCP Servers Configuration for Codex\n# Enhanced MCP server configurations with Serena, ArXiv, GitHub integration\n\nservers:\n  # Serena - Advanced code intelligence and analysis\n  serena:\n    command: \"npx\"\n    args: [\"@modelcontextprotocol/server-serena\", \"--port\", \"3001\"]\n    env:\n      MCP_SERENA_MODEL: \"gpt-4o\"\n      MCP_SERENA_MAX_TOKENS: \"100000\"\n    capabilities:\n      - \"code-analysis\"\n      - \"semantic-search\"\n      - \"refactoring-suggestions\"\n      - \"dependency-analysis\"\n\n  # ArXiv - Academic paper search and analysis\n  arxiv:\n    command: \"python\"\n    args: [\"-m\", \"arxiv_mcp_server\"]\n    env:\n      ARXIV_MAX_RESULTS: \"50\"\n      ARXIV_SORT_BY: \"relevance\"\n    capabilities:\n      - \"academic-search\"\n      - \"paper-analysis\"\n      - \"citation-extraction\"\n      - \"research-synthesis\"\n\n  # GitHub - Repository and issue management\n  github:\n    command: \"node\"\n    args: [\"dist/github-mcp-server.js\"]\n    env:\n      GITHUB_TOKEN: \"${GITHUB_TOKEN}\"\n      GITHUB_API_BASE: \"https://api.github.com\"\n    capabilities:\n      - \"repo-search\"\n      - \"issue-management\"\n      - \"pr-analysis\"\n      - \"code-review\"\n      - \"contributor-insights\"\n\n  # Enhanced filesystem with git integration\n  git-enhanced:\n    command: \"git-enhanced-mcp\"\n    args: [\"--enable-git-log\", \"--enable-blame\"]\n    capabilities:\n      - \"git-history\"\n      - \"code-blame\"\n      - \"commit-analysis\"\n      - \"branch-comparison\"\n\n  # Documentation analyzer\n  docs-analyzer:\n    command: \"docs-analyzer-mcp\"\n    args: [\"--support-formats\", \"md,pdf,html,docx\"]\n    capabilities:\n      - \"document-parsing\"\n      - \"content-extraction\"\n      - \"structure-analysis\"\n      - \"search-indexing\"\n\n  # YouTube - Video search and analysis\n  youtube:\n    ",

        "contents": "project_doc_fallback_filenames = []\n\n################################################################################\n# Tools (legacy toggles kept for compatibility)\n################################################################################\n\n[tools]\n# Enable web search tool (alias: web_search_request). Default: false\nweb_search = false\n\n# Enable the view_image tool so the agent can attach local images. Default: true\nview_image = true\n\n# (Alias accepted) You can also write:\n# web_search_request = false\n\n################################################################################\n# Centralized Feature Flags (preferred)\n################################################################################\n\n[features]\n# Leave this table empty to accept defaults. Set explicit booleans to opt in/out.\nunified_exec = false\napply_patch_freeform = false\nview_image_tool = true\nweb_search_request = false\nenable_experimental_windows_sandbox = false\nskills = false\n\n################################################################################\n# Experimental toggles (legacy; prefer [features])\n################################################################################\n\n# Include apply_patch via freeform editing path (affects default tool set).         "contents": "pub enum Feature {\n    // Stable.\n    /// Create a ghost commit at each turn.\n    GhostCommit,\n    /// Include the view_image tool.\n    ViewImageTool,\n    /// Send warnings to the model to correct it on the tool usage.\n    ModelWarnings,\n    /// Enable the default shell tool.\n    ShellTool,\n\n    // Experimental\n    /// Use the single unified PTY-backed exec tool.\n    UnifiedExec,\n    /// Include the freeform apply_patch tool.\n    ApplyPatchFreeform,\n    /// Allow the model to request web searches.\n    WebSearchRequest,\n    /// Gate the execpolicy enforcement for shell/unified exec.\n    ExecPolicy,\n    /// Enable Windows sandbox (restricted token) on Windows.\n    WindowsSandbox,\n    /// Use the elevated Windows sandbox pipeline (setup + runner).\n    WindowsSandboxElevated,\n    /// Remote compaction enabled (only for ChatGPT auth)\n    RemoteCompaction,\n    /// Refresh remote models and emit AppReady once the list is available.\n    RemoteModels,\n    /// Allow model to call multiple tools in parallel (only for models supporting it).\n    ParallelToolCalls,\n    /// Experimental shell snapshotting.\n    ShellSnapshot,\n    /// Experimental TUI v2 (viewport) implementation.\n    Tui2,\n    /// Enable discovery and injection of skills.\n    Skills,\n    /// Enforce UTF8 output in Powershell.\n    PowershellUtf8,\n}\n\nimpl Feature {\n    pub fn key(self) -&gt; &amp;'static str {\n        self.info().key\n    }\n\n    pub fn stage(self) -&gt; Stage {\n        self.info().stage\n    }\n\n    pub fn default_enabled(self) -&gt; bool {\n        self.info().default_enabled\n    }\n\n    fn info(self) -&gt; &amp;'static FeatureSpec {\n        FEATURES\n            .iter()\n            .find(|spec| spec.id == self)\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| unreachable!(\"missing FeatureSpec for {:?}\", self))\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]\npub struct LegacyFeatureUsage {\n    pub alias: String,\n    pub feature: Feature,\n}\n\n/// Holds the effective set of enabled features.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq)]\npub struct Features {\n    enabled: BTreeSet&lt;Feature&gt;,",

        },
        "contents": "pub struct Features {\n    enabled: BTreeSet&lt;Feature&gt;,\n    legacy_usages: BTreeSet&lt;LegacyFeatureUsage&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]\npub struct FeatureOverrides {\n    pub include_apply_patch_tool: Option&lt;bool&gt;,\n    pub web_search_request: Option&lt;bool&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl FeatureOverrides {\n    fn apply(self, features: &amp;mut Features) {\n        LegacyFeatureToggles {\n            include_apply_patch_tool: self.include_apply_patch_tool,\n            tools_web_search: self.web_search_request,\n            ..Default::default()\n        }\n        .apply(features);\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Features {\n    /// Starts with built-in defaults.\n    pub fn with_defaults() -&gt; Self {\n        let mut set = BTreeSet::new();\n        for spec in FEATURES {\n            if spec.default_enabled {\n                set.insert(spec.id);\n            }\n        }\n        Self {\n            enabled: set,\n            legacy_usages: BTreeSet::new(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn enabled(&amp;self, f: Feature) -&gt; bool {\n        self.enabled.contains(&amp;f)\n    }\n\n    pub fn enable(&amp;mut self, f: Feature) -&gt; &amp;mut Self {\n        self.enabled.insert(f);\n        self\n    }\n\n    pub fn disable(&amp;mut self, f: Feature) -&gt;         "contents": ",\n}\n\nimpl LegacyFeatureToggles {\n    pub fn apply(self, features: &amp;mut Features) {\n        set_if_some(\n            features,\n            Feature::ApplyPatchFreeform,\n            self.include_apply_patch_tool,\n            \"include_apply_patch_tool\",\n        );\n        set_if_some(\n            features,\n            Feature::ApplyPatchFreeform,\n            self.experimental_use_freeform_apply_patch,\n            \"experimental_use_freeform_apply_patch\",\n        );\n        set_if_some(\n            features,\n            Feature::UnifiedExec,\n            self.experimental_use_unified_exec_tool,\n            \"experimental_use_unified_exec_tool\",\n        );\n        set_if_some(\n            features,\n            Feature::WebSearchRequest,\n            self.tools_web_search,\n            \"tools.web_search\",\n        );\n        set_if_some(\n            features,\n            Feature::ViewImageTool,\n            self.tools_view_image,\n            \"tools.view_image\",\n        );\n    }\n}\n\nfn set_if_some(\n    features: &amp;mut Features,\n    feature: Feature,\n    maybe_value: Option&lt;bool&gt;,\n    alias_key: &amp;'static str,\n) {\n    if let Some(enabled) = maybe_value {\n        set_feature(features, feature, enabled);\n        log_alias(alias_key, feature);\n        features.record_legacy_usage(alias_key, feature);\n    }\n}\n\nfn set_feature(features: &amp;mut Features, feature: Feature, enabled: bool) {\n    if enabled {\n        features.enable(feature);\n    } else {\n        features.disable(feature);\n    }\n}\n\nfn log_alias(alias: &amp;str, feature: Feature) {\n    let canonical = feature.key();\n    if alias == canonical {\n        return;\n    }\n    info!(\n        %alias,\n        canonical,\n        \"legacy feature toggle detected; prefer &#96;[features].{canonical}&#96;\"\n    );\n}",

        "contents": "# Codex Minimal Configuration - 動作確認済みMCPサーバーのみ\n# 作成日: 2025-10-25\n# 目的: 高速起動・安定動作\n\n# ==================== モデル設定 ====================\nmodel = \"gpt-5-codex\"\n\n# 🆕 MCP Client機能を有効化\n# ⚠️ experimental_use_rmcp_client は現在問題があるため無効化\nexperimental_use_rmcp_client = false\n\n# 🔍 Web検索機能を有効化（モデル組み込み検索）\nenable_web_search = true\n\n# ==================== 機能フラグ ====================\n[features]\n# Web検索機能（モデル組み込み）\nweb_search = true\n# MCP統合\nmcp_integration = true\n\n# ==================== OpenAI Provider ====================\n[model_providers.openai]\nbase_url = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"\nenv_key = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\"\nname = \"OpenAI (Chat Completions API)\"\nrequires_openai_auth = true\nwire_api = \"chat\"\n# 🔍 Web検索機能を有効化\nenable_web_search = true\nweb_search_grounding = true\n\n# ==================== セキュリティ ====================\n[sandbox]\ndefault_mode = \"read-only\"\n\n[approval]\npolicy = \"on-request\"\n\n# ==================== MCP サーバー ====================\n# ✅ 動作確認済みサーバーのみ（2/15）\n\n# Codex MCP Server - メインサーバー（7ツール利用可能）\n[mcp_servers.codex]\nargs = [\"mcp-server\"]\ncommand = \"codex\"\nenv.GITHUB_TOKEN = \"${GITHUB_TOKEN}\"\nenv.OPENAI_API_KEY = \"${OPENAI_API_KEY}\"\nenv.RUST_LOG = \"info\"\nenv.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL = \"${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL}\"\nstartup_timeout_sec = 60\n\n# Gemini CLI - Google Gemini AI統合（OAuth 2.0、Google Search機能付き）\n# ⚠️ Note: Requires 'gemini' CLI to be installed\n[mcp_servers.codex-gemini-mcp]\nargs = []\ncommand = \"codex-gemini-mcp\"\ndescription = \"Codex Gemini CLI MCP Server v0.49.0 - Google Gemini AI integration with OAuth 2.0 authentication and Google Search Grounding\"\ndisabled = true\nenv.PATH = \"C:\\\\Users\\\\downl\\\\.cargo\\\\bin;${PATH}\"\nstartup_timeout_sec = 60\n\n# ==================== サブエージェント ====================\n[subagents]\nenabled = true\ninherit_model = true\nmax_parallel = 4",

        },
        "contents": "# Codex Secure Configuration (TLS/mTLS + Encrypted Agents)\n# バージョン: v0.51.0-zapabob.1 (Secure Edition)\n# 作成日: 2025-10-28\n# 設計書: _docs/2025-10-28_セキュア通信アーキテクチャ設計書.md\n#\n# 📋 使用方法:\n#   1. zapabob/scripts/generate-mcp-certs.ps1 を実行して証明書生成\n#   2. config.toml をこのファイルで置き換えるか、設定をマージ\n#   3. codex --config config-secure.toml で起動\n\n# ==================== 基本設定 ====================\nmodel = \"gpt-5-codex\"\n\n# 🆕 MCP Client機能を有効化\nexperimental_use_rmcp_client = true\n\n# 🔍 Web検索機能を有効化（モデル組み込み検索）\nenable_web_search = true\n\n# ==================== 機能フラグ ====================\n[features]\n# Web検索機能（モデル組み込み）\nweb_search = true\n# MCP統合\nmcp_integration = true\n# 🔐 セキュアモード（TLS/mTLS + 暗号化）\nsecure_mode = true\n\n# ==================== OpenAI Provider ====================\n[model_providers.openai]\nbase_url = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"\nenv_key = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\"\nname = \"OpenAI (Chat Completions API)\"\nrequires_openai_auth = true\nwire_api = \"chat\"\nenable_web_search = true\nweb_search_grounding = true\n\n# ==================== セキュリティ ====================\n[security]\n# ゼロトラストモード\nzero_trust_mode = true\n\n# TLS/mTLS設定\ntls_enabled = true\ntls_version = \"1.3\"  # TLS 1.3のみ許可（TLS 1.2以下は拒否）\nmtls_enabled = true  # 相互TLS認証（クライアント証明書必須）\n\n[security.certificates]\n# 証明書パス（~/.codex/certs/）\nca_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/ca/ca-cert.pem\"\nclient_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/codex/codex-cert.pem\"\nclient_key = \"~/.codex/certs/codex/codex-key.pem\"\nverify_peer = true  # ピア証明書の検証を強制\n\n# 証明書ローテーション\n[security.certificates.rotation]\nenabled = true\nrotation_days = 90  # 90日ごとに自動ローテーション\nwarn_before_expiry_days = 14  # 14日前に警告\n\n[security.signing]",

        "contents": "impl ToolsConfig {\n    pub fn new(params: &amp;ToolsConfigParams) -&gt; Self {\n        let ToolsConfigParams {\n            model_family,\n            features,\n        } = params;\n        let include_apply_patch_tool = features.enabled(Feature::ApplyPatchFreeform);\n        let include_web_search_request = features.enabled(Feature::WebSearchRequest);\n        let include_view_image_tool = features.enabled(Feature::ViewImageTool);\n\n        let shell_type = if !features.enabled(Feature::ShellTool) {\n            ConfigShellToolType::Disabled\n        } else if features.enabled(Feature::UnifiedExec) {\n            // If ConPTY not supported (for old Windows versions), fallback on ShellCommand.\n            if codex_utils_pty::conpty_supported() {\n                ConfigShellToolType::UnifiedExec\n            } else {\n                ConfigShellToolType::ShellCommand\n            }\n        } else {\n            model_family.shell_type\n        };\n\n        let apply_patch_tool_type = match model_family.apply_patch_tool_type {\n            Some(ApplyPatchToolType::Freeform) =&gt; Some(ApplyPatchToolType::Freeform),\n            Some(ApplyPatchToolType::Function) =&gt; Some(ApplyPatchToolType::Function),\n            None =&gt; {\n                if include_apply_patch_tool {\n                    Some(ApplyPatchToolType::Freeform)\n                } else {\n                    None\n                }\n            }\n        };\n\n        Self {\n            shell_type,\n            apply_patch_tool_type,\n            web_search_request: include_web_search_request,\n            include_view_image_tool,\n            experimental_supported_tools: model_family.experimental_supported_tools.clone(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Generic JSON‑Schema subset needed for our tool definitions\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]\n#[serde(tag = \"type\", rename_all = \"lowercase\")]\npub(crate) enum JsonSchema {\n    Boolean",

        "contents": "# Codex Minimal Configuration - 動作確認済みMCPサーバーのみ\n# 作成日: 2025-10-25\n# 目的: 高速起動・安定動作\n\n# ==================== モデル設定 ====================\nmodel = \"gpt-5-codex\"\n\n# 🆕 MCP Client機能を有効化\n# ⚠️ experimental_use_rmcp_client は現在問題があるため無効化\nexperimental_use_rmcp_client = false\n\n# 🔍 Web検索機能を有効化（モデル組み込み検索）\nenable_web_search = true\n\n# ==================== 機能フラグ ====================\n[features]\n# Web検索機能（モデル組み込み）\nweb_search = true\n# MCP統合\nmcp_integration = true\n\n# ==================== OpenAI Provider ====================\n[model_providers.openai]\nbase_url = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"\nenv_key = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\"\nname = \"OpenAI (Chat Completions API)\"\nrequires_openai_auth = true\nwire_api = \"chat\"\n# 🔍 Web検索機能を有効化\nenable_web_search = true\nweb_search_grounding = true\n\n# ==================== セキュリティ ====================\n[sandbox]\ndefault_mode = \"read-only\"\n\n[approval]\npolicy = \"on-request\"\n\n# ==================== MCP サーバー ====================\n# ✅ 動作確認済みサーバーのみ（2/15）\n\n# Codex MCP Server - メインサーバー（7ツール利用可能）\n[mcp_servers.codex]\nargs = [\"mcp-server\"]\ncommand = \"codex\"\nenv.GITHUB_TOKEN = \"${GITHUB_TOKEN}\"\nenv.OPENAI_API_KEY = \"${OPENAI_API_KEY}\"\nenv.RUST_LOG = \"info\"\nenv.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL = \"${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL}\"\nstartup_timeout_sec = 60\n\n# Gemini CLI - Google Gemini AI統合（OAuth 2.0、Google Search機能付き）\n# ⚠️ Note: Requires 'gemini' CLI to be installed\n[mcp_servers.codex-gemini-mcp]\nargs = []\ncommand = \"codex-gemini-mcp\"\ndescription = \"Codex Gemini CLI MCP Server v0.49.0 - Google Gemini AI integration with OAuth 2.0 authentication and Google Search Grounding\"\ndisabled = true\nenv.PATH = \"C:\\\\Users\\\\downl\\\\.cargo\\\\bin;${PATH}\"\nstartup_timeout_sec = 60\n\n# ==================== サブエージェント ====================\n[subagents]\nenabled = true\ninherit_model = true\nmax_parallel = 4",

        "contents": "pub struct LogoutArgs {\n    /// Name of the MCP server to deauthenticate.\n    pub name: String,\n}\n\n/// Dynamic loading subcommands for runtime MCP server management\n#[derive(Debug, clap::Parser)]\npub struct DynamicArgs {\n    #[command(subcommand)]\n    pub subcommand: DynamicSubcommand,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, clap::Subcommand)]\npub enum DynamicSubcommand {\n    /// Add a server dynamically at runtime\n    Add(DynamicAddArgs),\n    /// Remove a server dynamically at runtime\n    Remove(DynamicRemoveArgs),\n    /// Reload a server with new configuration\n    Reload(DynamicReloadArgs),\n    /// List dynamically loaded servers\n    List,\n    /// Start watching configuration files for changes\n    Watch,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, clap::Parser)]\npub struct DynamicAddArgs {\n    /// Name for the MCP server\n    pub name: String,\n    /// Path to server configuration file (TOML or YAML)\n    #[arg(long)]\n    pub config: Option&lt;std::path::PathBuf&gt;,\n    /// Command to launch the MCP server (for stdio transport)\n    #[arg(long, num_args = 1..)]\n    pub command: Option&lt;Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt;,\n    /// URL for streamable HTTP transport\n    #[arg(long)]\n    pub url: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, clap::Parser)]\npub struct DynamicRemoveArgs {\n    /// Name of the MCP server to remove\n    pub name: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, clap::Parser)]\npub struct DynamicReloadArgs {\n    /// Name of the MCP server to reload\n    pub name: String,\n    /// Path to new server configuration file\n    #[arg(long)]\n    pub config: Option&lt;std::path::PathBuf&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl McpCli {\n    pub async fn run(self) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt;",

        "contents": "    if let McpServerTransportConfig::StreamableHttp {\n        url,\n        bearer_token_env_var: _,\n        http_headers,\n        env_http_headers,\n    } = transport\n    {\n        match supports_oauth_login(&amp;url).await {\n            Ok(true) =&gt; {\n                println!(\"Detected OAuth support. Starting OAuth flow…\");\n                perform_oauth_login(\n                    &amp;name,\n                    &amp;url,\n                    config.mcp_oauth_credentials_store_mode,\n                    http_headers.clone(),\n                    env_http_headers.clone(),\n                    &amp;Vec::new(),\n                )\n                .await?;\n                println!(\"Successfully logged in.\");\n            }\n            Ok(false) =&gt; {}\n            Err(_) =&gt; println!(\n                \"MCP server may or may not require login.         "contents": "    let config = DeepResearcherConfig {\n        max_depth: actual_plan.stop_conditions.max_depth,\n        max_sources: actual_plan.stop_conditions.max_sources as u8,\n        strategy: ResearchStrategy::Comprehensive,\n    };\n\n    let researcher = DeepResearcher::new(config, provider);\n    let report = researcher\n        .research(&amp;topic)\n        .await\n        .context(\"Failed to conduct research\")?;\n\n    println!(\"\\n📊 Research Report:\");\n    println!(\"   Query: {}\", report.query);\n    println!(\"   Strategy: {:?}\", report.strategy);\n    println!(\"   Depth reached: {}\", report.depth_reached);\n    println!(\"   Sources found: {}\", report.sources.len());\n    println!(\"   Diversity score: {:.2}\", report.diversity_score);\n    println!(\"   Confidence: {:?}\", report.confidence_level);\n\n    if let Some(ref contradictions) = report.contradictions {\n        println!(\n            \"\\n⚠️ Contradictions detected: {}\",\n            contradictions.contradiction_count\n        );\n        for (i, contradiction) in contradictions.contradictions.iter().enumerate().take(3) {\n            println!(\"   {}. {}\", i + 1, contradiction.description);\n        }\n    }\n\n    println!(\"\\n📝 Summary:\");\n    println!(\"{}\", report.summary);\n\n    println!(\"\\n🔗 Sources:\");\n    for (i, source) in report.sources.iter().enumerate() {\n        println!(\"   [{}] {} - {}\", i + 1, source.title, source.url);\n    }\n\n    let out_path = out.unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(\"artifacts/report.md\"));\n    if let Some(parent) = out_path.parent() {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n    }\n\n    let markdown = generate_markdown_report(&amp;report);\n    std::fs::write(&amp;out_path, markdown)?;\n\n    println!(\"\\n💾 Report saved to: {}\", out_path.display());\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn generate_markdown_report(report: &amp;codex_deep_research::types::ResearchReport",

        "contents": "fn parse_env_pair(raw: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;(String, String), String&gt; {\n    let mut parts = raw.splitn(2, '=');\n    let key = parts\n        .next()\n        .map(str::trim)\n        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())\n        .ok_or_else(|| \"environment entries must be in KEY=VALUE form\".to_string())?;\n    let value = parts\n        .next()\n        .map(str::to_string)\n        .ok_or_else(|| \"environment entries must be in KEY=VALUE form\".to_string())?;\n\n    Ok((key.to_string(), value))\n}\n\nfn validate_server_name(name: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n    let is_valid = !name.is_empty()\n        &amp;&amp; name\n            .chars()\n            .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '-' || c == '_');\n\n    if is_valid {\n        Ok(())\n    } else {\n        bail!(\"invalid server name '{name}' (use letters, numbers, '-', '_')\");\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "async fn run_logout(config_overrides: &amp;CliConfigOverrides, logout_args: LogoutArgs) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n    let overrides = config_overrides\n        .parse_overrides()\n        .map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;\n    let config = Config::load_with_cli_overrides(overrides)\n        .await\n        .context(\"failed to load configuration\")?;\n\n    let LogoutArgs { name } = logout_args;\n\n    let server = config\n        .mcp_servers\n        .get(&amp;name)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No MCP server named '{name}' found in configuration.\"))?;\n\n    let url = match &amp;server.transport {\n        McpServerTransportConfig::StreamableHttp { url, .. } =&gt; url.clone(),\n        _ =&gt; bail!(\"OAuth logout is only supported for streamable_http transports.\"),\n    };\n\n    match delete_oauth_tokens(&amp;name, &amp;url, config.mcp_oauth_credentials_store_mode) {\n        Ok(true) =&gt; println!(\"Removed OAuth credentials for '{name}'.\"),\n        Ok(false) =&gt; println!(\"No OAuth credentials stored for '{name}'.\"),\n        Err(err) =&gt; return Err(anyhow!(\"failed to delete OAuth credentials: {err}\")),\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nasync fn run_list(config_overrides: &amp;CliConfigOverrides, list_args: ListArgs)",

        "contents": "pub struct LogoutArgs {\n    /// Name of the MCP server to deauthenticate.\n    pub name: String,\n}\n\n/// Dynamic loading subcommands for runtime MCP server management\n#[derive(Debug, clap::Parser)]\npub struct DynamicArgs {\n    #[command(subcommand)]\n    pub subcommand: DynamicSubcommand,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, clap::Subcommand)]\npub enum DynamicSubcommand {\n    /// Add a server dynamically at runtime\n    Add(DynamicAddArgs),\n    /// Remove a server dynamically at runtime\n    Remove(DynamicRemoveArgs),\n    /// Reload a server with new configuration\n    Reload(DynamicReloadArgs),\n    /// List dynamically loaded servers\n    List,\n    /// Start watching configuration files for changes\n    Watch,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, clap::Parser)]\npub struct DynamicAddArgs {\n    /// Name for the MCP server\n    pub name: String,\n    /// Path to server configuration file (TOML or YAML)\n    #[arg(long)]\n    pub config: Option&lt;std::path::PathBuf&gt;,\n    /// Command to launch the MCP server (for stdio transport)\n    #[arg(long, num_args = 1..)]\n    pub command: Option&lt;Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt;,\n    /// URL for streamable HTTP transport\n    #[arg(long)]\n    pub url: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, clap::Parser)]\npub struct DynamicRemoveArgs {\n    /// Name of the MCP server to remove\n    pub name: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, clap::Parser)]\npub struct DynamicReloadArgs {\n    /// Name of the MCP server to reload\n    pub name: String,\n    /// Path to new server configuration file\n    #[arg(long)]\n    pub config: Option&lt;std::path::PathBuf&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl McpCli {\n    pub async fn run(self) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt;",

        "contents": "async fn run_get(config_overrides: &amp;CliConfigOverrides, get_args: GetArgs) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n    let overrides = config_overrides\n        .parse_overrides()\n        .map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;\n    let config = Config::load_with_cli_overrides(overrides)\n        .await\n        .context(\"failed to load configuration\")?;\n\n    let Some(server) = config.mcp_servers.get(&amp;get_args.name) else {\n        bail!(\"No MCP server named '{name}' found.\", name = get_args.name);\n    };\n\n    if get_args.json {\n        let transport = match &amp;server.transport {\n            McpServerTransportConfig::Stdio {\n                command,\n                args,\n                env,\n                env_vars,\n                cwd,\n            } =&gt; serde_json::json!({\n                \"type\": \"stdio\",\n                \"command\": command,\n                \"args\": args,\n                \"env\": env,\n                \"env_vars\": env_vars,\n                \"cwd\": cwd,\n            }),\n            McpServerTransportConfig::StreamableHttp {\n                url,\n                bearer_token_env_var,\n                http_headers,\n                env_http_headers,\n            } =&gt; serde_json::json!({\n                \"type\": \"streamable_http\",\n                \"url\": url,\n                \"bearer_token_env_var\": bearer_token_env_var,\n                \"http_headers\": http_headers,\n                \"env_http_headers\": env_http_headers,\n            }),\n        };\n        let output = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&amp;serde_json::json!({\n            \"name\": get_args.name,\n            \"enabled\": server.enabled,\n            \"transport\": transport,\n            \"enabled_tools\": server.enabled_tools.clone(),\n            \"disabled_tools\": server.disabled_tools.clone(),\n            \"startup_timeout_sec\": server\n                .startup_timeout_sec\n                .map(|timeout| timeout.as_secs_f64()),\n            \"tool_timeout_sec\": server\n                .tool_timeout_sec\n                .map(|timeout| timeout.as_secs_f64()),\n        }))?;\n        println!(\"{output}\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    if !server.enabled",
